Event Name: Bringing Cultural Education to Global Game Table
Description:
`Board games have always carried culture - the stories a society tells, the values it teaches, and the way it defines winning and losing. But what happens when those games cross borders?
In this session, a practitioners share firsthand experience bringing culturally rooted games from local markets to global tables - navigating language, identity, and design along the way. Description:
You remember when all you had to worry about was the world ending.
But now it's not just the end of the world; it's the end of every world. God-Emperor Jafar's madness has spread across the cosmos, dragging world after world into darkness.
You're here to make a desperate last stand - a final strike against his stronghold at Neo-Aggrabah. Your odds aren't good, but it's the only option you have left.
This is a Kingdom Hearts-themed TTRPG with a heavy emphasis on action and tragedy using the Anima Prime system. Characters will be provided, though players will have the option to make their own.

Description:
Welcome to The Spiral
For centuries, it has tempted adventurers and explorers, eager to claim its untold riches. But, after countless attempts and expeditions, none who have entered this cursed land have returned. 
Nonetheless, you and your crew are determined to get the treasure. 
But in The Spiral, you can't see around the bend, and each step could be your last. Hazards and obstacles block the path, and bloodthirsty monsters await to slaughter your team. 
Will your crew be the first to conquer the unforgiving territory, or will you join all the others who failed? Roll the dice and find out.

Your lord is dead. Slain not in battle, but betrayed in silence. Poisoned at a banquet by the Daimyō who once called him brother.
Now his killers sit behind lacquered walls, protected by hired blades and political silence. No court will hear your case. No allies will march at your side. The world has already moved on.

Pride Gamers of Columbus Presents...

The Obsidian Outlaw's reign of terror has come to an end!  The former master of disguise has finally been found, having come afoul of some other criminal's gun.  There are few tears to be said... but as Detective Rose arrives in town, there are still a lot of questions to answer about the Outlaw's fate... and which of the townspeople is responsible.

Your party are members of the Fire Squad - heroes that dive beneath flames and jump into smoke to extinguish infernos. River Valley becomes a bustling hub as clever woodland creatures gather shimmering glass from the river. In River Valley Glassworks, you draft glass by placing one of your pieces onto a matching river tile and selecting an adjacent tile to collect from. The river then shifts, revealing fresh options.

Back at your shop, arrange your collected glass carefully. Your scoring depends on how you fill rows and columns, earning bonuses for smart placement while avoiding penalties for collecting too much of any single type.

Premise: Magic is dying, and so is the Magus, the last powerful wizard.
​The Journey: Players take on the roles of the Magus's companions on a desperate journey to Umbra, the birthplace of all magic, in a final attempt to save it.
​The Experience: The game is played on a long, unrolling canvas map that reveals new locations and story prompts as the travelers progress. Players collaboratively tell the story of their characters' relationships, transformations, and experiences on this melancholic, epic quest.

We'll have breaks for snacks and restroom visits.

You and your team of fellow baristas arrive at the Golden Dawn Cafe every morning to get your customers off on the right foot. But something is very wrong. The doors are locked, your manager is missing, and the latest batch of coffee from the roastery is putting people to sleep instead of waking them up. It’s time for you to roll up your sleeves, deviate from your daily grind, and get to the bottom of this little cup o’ crazy!
Room: Hyatt - 1st Floor - Grant Room- Evil Genius Games

Description: New Players welcome! Rules taught, pregen heroes available. No experience needed. A wealthy patron has built indoor mountains and beaches. What elaborate traps await the heroes trying to steal a piece of Project: Kaleidoscope?
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: Hyatt - 1st Floor - Grant Room- Evil Genius Games

Description: “Solving murders was supposed to be the hobby… not the gateway to something far worse.” In this cozy-meets-cosmic mystery, you play a group of sharp-witted elderly women in a quiet New England town, unraveling deadly cases that hint at a hidden occult conspiracy beneath the surface. Inspired by Murder, She Wrote with a touch of Lovecraftian dread, this low-prep, beginner-friendly RPG is perfect for players of all experience levels who enjoy clever sleuthing, quirky characters, and creeping horror.
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Delaware A-D Rooms- The Gathering

Description: Cavemen will compete to bag the most and best Animals in a point value competition.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2308 - HMGS - GL

Description: Games Workshop's small gang system set in the universe of 40K - gangs will evolve through the convention
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2412 - SGG

Event Name: Legends of Greyhawk - Deceit within the Elemental Cults
Description: Divided by element and riven by ambition, the four Cults of Elemental Evil serve a common cause that promises an apocalypse upon the unbelievers. Can you worm your way into their confidence or will your story end as one more sacrifice on the Temple's altar? A 4-hour Legends of Greyhawk Adventure for characters 1st to 4th level.
Room: Hyatt Regency Ballroom - D&D - Baldman Games

Event Name: Legends of Greyhawk - Upstream of Catastrophe
Description: Zuggtmoy’s spores infect the land around the Temple of Elemental Evil as her corruption takes root and propagates. It’s only a matter of time before she consumes everything in her path! The surrounding lands must be warned, and the blight must be contained before it’s too late. A Legends of Greyhawk adventure for level 5-10 characters.
Room: Hyatt Regency Ballroom - D&D - Baldman Games

Description: A gut-punch of a game that pits two to six players in an epic team battle over a pioneer town. The question is: are you feeling like a pioneer, or a renegade? Do you want to build the town, or burn it down? It is a game drenched in theme--from keeping track of the game rounds by loading bullets into a revolver chamber, to the tongue-in-cheek descriptions on the cards. Strategy and luck take equal roles as you out-shoot, out-gamble and outsmart the other team to victory!
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2104 - Mid Level Meeple

Description: Variant rules taught but not base game rules.  Come to play just for fun or to compete in the tournament.  Collect cards & claim routes to fulfill your destinations.  Semi-Finals on Saturday at 6 pm.  For more info:  tinyurl.com/TGAOrigins2026
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2222 - TGA

Description: Behind the gates of an affluent Atlanta suburb, children vanish without a trace—never reported, never seen again. When a desperate investigator calls in Delta Green, agents uncover a chilling secret lurking beneath wealth and privilege. Some horrors don’t stay buried. Horror RPG, all skill levels, pre-generated characters provided.
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Delaware A-D Rooms- The Gathering

Description: You are the ruler of a growing kingdom. Your prophets have warned that famine will sweep the entire land over the next few years. To save your people, you’ll need to hire the right workers, balance your resources, and even call upon the magic of mighty wizards! Can you finish the third year with more grain than competing rulers and secure prosperity for your kingdom?
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2104 - Mid Level Meeple

Description: The Call of Cthulhu horror and mystery TTRPG brought into the board gaming world! Come participate in this latest boardgame offering from Chaosium.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2112 - Chaosium

Description: Try an independent, small press role-playing game! GAMES ON DEMAND offers enthusiastic and talented GMs who run rules-light, story-rich, and easy-to-learn RPGs for players. Just show up, look at the game menus, and sign up for an expertly-run role-playing game.
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Fairfield Room- Indie Games on Demand

Description: This is a social deduction game where the "bad guy" changes from round to round.  The Space Corps Ship Sultanna had a crew of over 300 - a strange energy being has destroyed all but a few who do not know each other that well.  The alien jumps from crewman to crewman hoping for an opportunity to destroy the ship before it reaches an SC port.  While the alien player each round will be keeping that secret, all of the players will also be wanting to keep their crew position secret and discover those of the other players.  The game takes between an hour an an hour-and-a-half.
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2530 - Rounds

Description: The Call of Cthulhu horror and mystery TTRPG brought into the board gaming world! Come participate in this latest boardgame offering from Chaosium.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2112 - Chaosium

Description: Mutant-zombie horror in the year 1390! Death is no longer final: those who die are revived with mutations of the spirit and flesh. Take on the roles of Pilgrims condemned to scrounge for resources outside the protection of their city-states. Use the highly adaptable Grit System to explore, and survive, a shattered world packed with historical fantasy, religio-political intrigue, and brutal combat. No previous experience or knowledge of history required.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2534 - Rounds

Description: A fast-paced & addictive game of gem collecting & card development. Players are merchants of the Renaissance trying to buy gem mines with means of transportation and shops all in order to acquire the most prestige points. You might even receive a visit from a noble at some point that will further increase your prestige.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2322 - Rising Phoenix Gaming Club

Event Name: Saloon Shootout: A Gunfights & Gamblin' Game
Description: You're a no-good varmint and a card cheat, so you've brought your own cards to the Saloon. The bad news for you is that everyone else at the table is a cheat, too! You'll have to take some risks and play your cards smart once tempers flare and bullets start to fly!
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2104 - Mid Level Meeple

Description: Go head-to-head with an opponent, each stepping into the shoes of an iconic leader from across Star Trek's galaxy and history. Try Captains from the original game, or the brand new To Boldly Go standalone or Second Contact expansions! Command ships, crew, and away teams, while you manage resources and alliances in this exciting deckbuilding game!
Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting C 162 - WizKids

Event Name: D&D Movie Magic: What Lies in Blackwood Forest (Thursday)
Description:
The forest has gone silent, and the few who entered it have not come back. Now, a small band has been sent to uncover the truth. The deeper you go, the darker it gets—and a terrible thought begins to take hold—you may not make it out alive.

A cinematic D&D 5e one-shot blending fantasy, horror, and survival—inspired by the plot of a certain 80s sci-fi classic... but which one? You’ll have to play to find out.

Characters provided, or bring your own 3rd-level Adventurers League–legal character. Full minis and terrain included.
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Marion Room

Event Name: Merchants of Andromeda - Learn to Play
Description: Seek riches in a game of space politics - casting votes in the Senate, bidding on lucrative space goods, or resorting to ship combat!
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2300 - Allplay Games

Description: Welcome to Alpha Complex! Here, we follow The Computer. Obeying the computer makes you happy, and happiness is mandatory. Some RPG's have rules that are applied objectively to help players work together to a heroic end. THAT IS NOT THIS GAME! In this scenario, the most trustworthy troubleshooters (YOU) will help dole out justice to those who deserve it most...TRAITORS TO THE COMPUTER! Stay alert! Trust No One! Keep your laser handy!
Room: Hyatt - 1st Floor - Hayes Room- Lurking Fears

Event Name: Marvel Mutiverse RPG: Avengers -Scarlet Letter NO More
Description: WHAT IF: X-Tinction Agenda triggered Magneto's Wrath? Part 1: The grand opening of the Museum of Avengers History was meant to be a triumph. Instead, a sudden chain of chaos shatters the celebration—leaving the Avengers gutted by a loss that cuts to their core. When the dust settles, the scarlet letter shall be no more… and only wrath remains. Characters Provided.
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Delaware A-D Rooms- The Gathering

Event Name: Using Games to Teach/Further Theatre Practices
Description: In this panel I will discuss my research and thesis on using Board Games, Video Games, and RPGs as tools for Theatre Practitioners to develop, teach, and hones skills related to all roles in the performing arts. I have been in the Theatre Arts for 22 years and hold a degree in Theatre. From Design, to directing, to acting these ideas will help anyone in the theatrical and performing arts, no matter the role. I have developed these ideas over the course of 12 years and given this panel at MAGFest twice and BroadwayCon once.
Room: GCCC - 2nd Floor - Meeting Room D #283 - Seminars & Panels

Description: Pirates, flying ships, a 3-D playing area, and steampunk. What is not to like. Quick easy rules.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2412 - SGG

Description: Welcome to my table. I am not much of a planner at the best of times, so why not see how far my improvisation can go? The rules are simple: each player gives one word or phrase, I will then create a fully playable one shot full of intrigue, characters, and tragedy that will incorporate all your words in a major way. let's see how silly this gets.
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - 2nd Floor - Meeting B #240 - Game Phylactery

Event Name: Kerberos Club Unlimited: From Atlantis With Love
Description: You are part of the Kerberos Club Unlimited, a band of ne'er-do-wells, revolutionaries, and scoundrels from across a collection of Infinite Victorian Earths. When an extradimensional entity known as Lady Seraphyne offers you purpose, power, and a chance to change the fate of countless worlds, how can you refuse? Think "League of Extraordinary Gentlemen" meets "Guardians of the Galaxy" and throw in a Steampunk team of Marvel's "Exiles" and you will be properly attired for this Savage Supers Adventure!
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Knox Room

Event Name: Rogues of Canguine, Ep. 2 - A Day Ending in "i"
Description: Start with a week-long celebration and a serious case of bottle-ache, add in skullduggery, a riot (or two) and the loss of an old friend. What do you get? A day ending in “i.”
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Clark Room- The Guild of San Marcos

Description: Trevor, Sypha, and party have been requested to investigate increase monster presence and several missing persons at the town of Talazynsk. The request itself is odd since Talazynsk has it's own hunter force. Investigate, save the town, hopefully don't die, and if your lucky you get some coin as a thank you instead of just words and some food. Based off the Netflix Series. Pre-generated characters will be provided.
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Franklin A Room- Matinee Adventures

Description: Designed to educate officers on joint force employment, you take charge of either the Axis or Allied forces in the Western Mediterranean in 1942-1943, using air, land, and naval forces.  The Allies have more combat power but must meet or beat the historical timeline for taking Tunis; the Axis run a delay operation but have opportunities to give the Allies a bloody nose and thereby delay the landings in Sicily and Italy.
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2312 - Armchair Dragoons

Description: "The slaughter at the Battle of the Somme in 1916 tore the veil between our world and realms unknown. From that wound crawled the demonic Others, eager to twist the Great War into something far worse. In this grim supernatural survival adventure, a battered squad of WW I soldiers, known only as the “Benothings” by command, find themselves cut off, outmatched, and stalked by enemies human and inhuman alike. Is a Benothing’s dream of home already lost to the mud and the Others? No experience necessary. TW:Body horror, blood/gore, supernatural/occult, violence (PG-13/R)"

His hotel room was been broken into, his valet murdered, and some old coins he had purchased were stolen.  Sir Roger asks for help.  Can our heroes solve the mystery of the Deadly Coins? Players take on the role of two fisted pulp heroes in this Thrilling Tales scenario.
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Morrow Room- Untold Stories Project

Join us to play on the largest, most immersive 3D version of the Nemesis in existence.

Description: A geopolitical strategy board game set in the modern world where major powers (MPs) pursue their own unique objectives with the "help" of the non-major powers.  Each MP (USA, W Europe, China, India, Russia) will have a unique objective and special ability.  MPs can influence, protect, and, if all else fails, invade the less powerful countries/regions around the globe in pursuit of their own agendas.  Optimizing spending and production will allow MPs to gain achievements that ultimately contribute to their victory conditions.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2430 - 6x30 Tables

Description: The Travellers awaken in a crashed spacecraft with only the vaguest memories of how they got there. First, they must survive, then discover how they came to be there. After that, their troubles really begin…
Room: Hyatt - 1st Floor - Hayes Room- Lurking Fears

Event Name: D&D 5E: That One May Smile and Smile
Description:
Bring your favorite PC back to Origins!  Collaborate with the DM before the convention to fit him/her/it into this high-level D&D 5e event by reading https://tinyurl.com/mjdy3ukf

NOTE:  THIS IS A CONTINUATION FROM ORIGINS 2025

Several high-level member of the consortium's special force have been found grisly murdered --- and, even worse, soulless!  These heinous crimes have been written off as simple "monster attacks" instead of investigated; you might be next, and you are no longer sure you can trust your superiors.  What choices are left to you?

Prizes! http://boarsheadgames.com

Event Name: Marvel Mutiverse RPG: X-Men- Asset Retrieval
Description: WHAT IF: X-Tinction Agenda triggered Magneto's Wrath? Part 2: A Genoshan strike force assaults the X-Mansion, sealing exits and striking from within. As chaos erupts, your heroes must protect students, uncover the true objective, and hold the line against overwhelming odds. Marvel action adventure, Characters Provided.
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Delaware A-D Rooms- The Gathering
Game Master (GM): Brennan O'Reagan, Jose Gonzalez, Rene Alfonso

Description: Are you bold enough to take your wig styling to the next level? This panel Con from Pros and Cons Cosplay will discuss the ins and outs of making a wig from scratch! Learn about the tools you need, steps you take, and a few tips and tricks to keep from pulling out your own hair making your own wig. We will apply these skills to make your own ponytail clip! Students should be comfortable using basic stitches on a sewing machine.
Room: GCCC - Union Station Ballroom C - Sewing & Craft Workshops
Game Master (GM): Con of Pros and Cons Cosplay

Event Name: Mold Making and Casting for Beginners
Description: Mold making and casting can add stability, rigidity, texture to projects! We will cover: safety, mold types, casting types and more. Attendees will use Mold Star and Smooth Cast to make their very own mini figurines and can keep it to take home.
Room: GCCC - Union Station Ballroom C - Sewing & Craft Workshops
Game Master (GM): Pro of Pros and Cons Cosplay

Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2222 - TGA

Description: When the zombie invasion took over the world’s mightiest heroes, most assumed everything was lost. The few surviving Avengers will not go down without a fight as the desperate battle between the living and the dead escalates. Old allies will need to be put down before they can devour every last person on the planet. So, assemble your Super Hero team, muster all the power you can, and become humanity’s last hope. This will not be a world of Marvel Zombies as long as the Heroes' Resistance lives on!

Join GM Sam as he introduces you to the Evolved Edition of Alien RPG.

Player's will be able to select to play any of the 7 Original Majors (Byzantium, Holy Roman, Kievan Rus, North Sea, England, France or Fatimid). In addition, 3 add-on minors can be utilized to allow a game with up to 10 players (Hungary, Qurtuba, or the Armenian). https://youtu.be/K-8MuSqZS5w
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)

Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2318 - NCG

Description: No, not copyrighted puppets. The Pigs are interplanetary bounty hunters, going wherever their warrants send them. Today you’re serving a Level 2 Warrant on a political agitator in the Rio Warrens–oh yeah, a place where they just love seeing Pigs doing their job. This should be “fun”.

Description: Step into a live, interactive fantasy adventure where each player chooses a hero class with unique abilities—cast spells, pick locks, brew potions, speak with animals, and uncover hidden secrets. Work together to explore the mystic woods, complete quests, and ultimately break the Warlock Fiend’s curse. A standalone adventure in the ARC Fantasy series.  (Smartphone required to use class abilities)

Description: Just another milk run to the Rim... where things are just too quiet, too perfect. A simple delivery turns into hard choices, and pulse-pounding action. Who saw that coming? A Firefly Season Two Adventure.

Up to 16 players compete in a 2 round, single elimination tournament. Winners from round 1 will proceed to the Carnival of Chaos for a 5-player round 2. Round 2 will feature a fresh Choppe Shoppe draft. Each board will feature incredible custom 3D terrain from Adrena Creative for maximum impact!

Some spectacles and venues of Rome were rekindled at Camelot. Harkening back to CIRCUS GIGANTICUS, the game CAMELOT DERBY allows players control brave LEGO knights as they race around the track and vie to survive, while their fellow knights, monsters, and centrifugal force threaten to stop them!

Remember, though, that to win the Student of the Year award, being quick won't be enough: you'll also need to brew the most valuable potions in Potion Explosion!

You're already funny, we promise! Join acclaimed improvisers Amy Vorpahl and Dave Hill for a playful workshop that organically explores your real sense of humor at the gaming table. No improv experience needed—just bring yourself!

Description:
The circus came without warning.
It never truly lets you leave.

RINGMASTER is a GM-less, prompt-driven story game (descended from For the Queen) that plays in about two hours with no prep or prior experience required.

Through prompts, we’ll discover how you joined this dark, supernatural circus, and what binds you to the troupe and its enigmatic Ringmaster. Is this your sanctuary… or your prison?

When an angry mob gathers outside the Big Top with torches raised, the choice becomes clear:
Will you defend your home — or watch it burn?

This event will teach all of the basics of the game system so you can then feel confident to play on your own or in our other Alpha Strike events.

Only the monsters with the most cards under them will score, but you also need those same monster cards in your hand to get points, so you have to decide when to play a monster card and when to keep it in your hand.

With The Creeps: The Monster-Trapping Game, you can play the "family game" for quicker games and younger audiences, or play the "full game" for asymmetric powers, game-changing trap cards, and more strategic scoring options.

Event Name: Fluorescent Paints. How do they even work?
Description:
Fluroescent paints are an amazing tool to get a bright, vibrant blast of color on our miniatures. However, they can be tricky to use! We will cover some of the pitfalls, benefits and properties of fluoro paints as we paint up a 54mm scale miniature in full vibrancy. We will discuss undercoating, mixing paints, blending techniques and more.

Basic painting skills are encouraged before taking this class. Students will be provided brushes, paints, and supplies for the duration of the class. Students will be provided a miniature for the class which they can take home.
Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting Room A 124 - Painting Classes

Description: Each year as the mid-summer festival begins, the seven panda clans gather to celebrate their many years of peace and prosperity. The panda clans each have their own powers and abilities, and the Elders consider those strengths carefully as they assemble their teams.This is a dice-drafting game.

Event Name: FluentSea, UPCOMING RELEASE Learn and Play!
Description:
Coming to Kickstarter Fall of 2026, FluentSea is a word-building, reef-restoration game where every word you make brings a bleached coral reef back to life. You build the best word you can each round, and the longer the word, the more marine species you get to place—like octopus, coral, clownfish, and schooling fish. Each species scores differently based on real behaviors, so clever wordplay and smart ecology both matter. Heal the reef, build the ecosystem, and score the most points to win.

Designed by David Gordon, Travis Magrum and Jon Glimour-Long with development by Leonie Grundler.

Your lord is dead. Slain not in battle, but betrayed in silence. Poisoned at a banquet by the Daimyō who once called him brother.
Now his killers sit behind lacquered walls, protected by hired blades and political silence. No court will hear your case. No allies will march at your side. The world has already moved on.

Each episode is packed with recreations of beautiful artifacts from the expedition. Players will use their magical expertise by allocating points to nine different Spheres of magical knowledge and influence: Correspondence, Entropy, Forces, Life, Mind, Matter, Prime, Spirit, and Time.

Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2330 - Minis Tables

Scions of the first liberators have volunteered to investigate. There is no need to play both parts of this adventure. CW: character death, slavery
Room: GCCC - 2nd Floor - Meeting Room D #280 - 8x30s

Description: The year is 1943 The war hangs in the balance.  Your characters, agents of a secret UK organization, are the last hope. You will be coffin-dropped behind enemy lines, right into the outskirts of Paris, where you need to make your way to the Eiffel Tower, manage to get atop the landmark to the zeppelin anchored there, and kill Hitler. Along the way, you get to kill any nazis you come into contact with. The game is definitely for mature players as it contains many acts of violence on the part of both players and npcs. It is also a rip-roaring good time and very cathartic.
Room: GCCC - 2nd Floor - Meeting Room D #280 - 8x30s

Event Name: Sparks #301 "We Need to Find a CLUE"
Description: "We Need to Find a CLUE", by R. Bailey. Attend a dinner party hosted by Imperial Researcher, Mr Body. He has information for the Rebel Alliance. Also in attendance is Colonel Mustard from the Imperial Navy, Miss Scarlet of the ISB, and Professor Plum from Theed University. What could go wrong? Game Base 7’s WEG ongoing Star Wars campaign. Start a character or bring an existing Sparks character. Sponsored by: Game Base 7.
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Madison Room- Game Base 7

Description: Build factories, produce containers, set prices, negotiate with your rivals, and sail across the sea to trade. Obviously, buy low, sell high. But, can you make it happen?
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2300 - Allplay Games

Event Name: Marvel Mutiverse RPG: Magneto’s Acolytes: Judgment Day!
Description: WHAT IF: X-Tinction Agenda triggered Magneto's Wrath? Part 3: Fueled by Magneto’s grief and rage over personal loss, the Acolytes declare their holy mission: Genosha must not endure, it must end. The island broke treaties, hunted mutants on U.S. soil, and now the reckoning comes. But retaliation spirals toward something far worse, something that pulls everyone toward war. Characters Provided.
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Delaware A-D Rooms- The Gathering

Forced to crash on a desolate desert planet, they must survive, while figuring out how to fix their ship. Are you worthy? Game Base 7’s WEG ongoing Star Wars campaign. Start a character or bring an existing Sparks character. Sponsored by: Game Base 7. Available for Replay.
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Madison Room- Game Base 7

Event Name: Legends of the Arena: Play to Win!

Legends of the Arena is a fast-paced fighting game for 1-6 players where you'll clash using unique abilities and tactical combat. Play a full game and the winner takes home a FREE COPY! Fresh from Kickstarter and making its retail debut at Origins!

Description: Reality is unraveling. Madame Web has foreseen a dark queen rising to destroy the Web of fate itself. Called to defend all creation, your heroes must face a threat that spans time and destiny. Will you save the Web… or watch it collapse? Epic Marvel adventure, Characters Provided.

Description: Explore the world of Cyberpunk as the hero of your own story, as you help a plucky team of edgerunners dismantle the nefarious Project Cyphon. In this installment, you’ve got 40 minutes to explore a private room inside the premiere night club Second Sight. Your goal? Break into the briefcase of the suit responsible for the Project Cyphon scheme, and secure the prototype for their upcoming tech release before it’s too late!

Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting Room B 142 - Roll Your Destiny

Description: Toil and trouble, ruin and rubble! Cross a witch and pay in pain... the keep will never be whole again! The Emerald Knight has perished, his life crushed by the fall of an ancient oak. His shattered keep has since become an accursed place of ill omen! What secrets and treasures lie buried in the ruins of this abandoned forest redoubt? 1st Level - Western Reaches Mini Adventures

You'll be laughing, crying, and gasping with your friends through this madcap Crooked Moon adventure!
Room: Hyatt - 1st Floor - Hayes Room- Lurking Fears

Slay the Spire: The Board Game is a co-operative deck-building, dungeon-crawling adventure. Craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, discover relics of immense power, and finally become strong enough to slay the Spire! 

Each player starts with a character with unique abilities and a simple deck of cards that they can improve by adding and removing cards during the game. The game is divided into Acts. At the end of an Act you can continue, stop and end the adventure there, or save and continue another time!
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2434 - 6x30 Tables

Description: Trudge through wetlands of Blackmoor to seek the rumored wonders of mysterious legends!

Room: Hyatt - 1st Floor - Hayes Room- Lurking Fears

Event Name: Shadow of the Weird Wizard - Desperate Measures
Description: When famine grips the land and hope runs dry, how far will you go to survive? In a borderland plagued by monsters and dark magic, desperate choices lead to even darker consequences. A grim fantasy adventure where survival may cost your humanity. All skill levels welcome, pre-generated characters provided.
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Delaware A-D Rooms- The Gathering

Will you earn a place in the war machine, serve the Black Coil, or walk a darker, sacred path? Your future is forged in the trial. Introductory adventure, characters provided.
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Delaware A-D Rooms- The Gathering

Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)

Room: Hyatt - 1st Floor - Hayes Room- Lurking Fears

Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2422 - Game Base 7

Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: Hyatt - 1st Floor - Grant Room- Evil Genius Games

Description: Old-world Italy awaits your winemaking skill and strategic cunning. the players find themselves in the roles of people in rustic, pre-modern Tuscany who have inherited meagre vineyards. They have a few plots of land, an old crush pad, a tiny cellar, and three workers. Using workers and visitors, the vineyard owners can expand their vineyards by building structures, planting vines, and filling wine orders, working towards the goal of running the most successful winery in Tuscany. This is Viticulture Tuscany Essential Edition using the four season board and structures.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2422 - Game Base 7

Description: Come adventure through WHPA-13 and help our trusty heroes figure out what is going on in Fairhaven!
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)

Room: Hyatt Regency Ballroom - D&D - Baldman Games

Room: Hyatt - 1st Floor - Grant Room- Evil Genius Games

Event Name: Legends of Greyhawk - Downwind of Disaster
Description: The Interdicted Prison has fallen, and Zuggtmoy, Demon Queen of Fungi, sends her spores drifting over the Gnarly Forest. As uncertainty takes hold of Hommlet, will you be able to gather unlikely allies in time to give the villagers a fighting chance? A Legends of Greyhawk adventure for level 5-10 characters.
Room: Hyatt Regency Ballroom - D&D - Baldman Games

Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2500 - Pro-Play Games

Description: Starbase Armstrong is an unpublished LARP-style gaming experience for 12 to 20 players. Set at an interstellar transit hub, players become aliens from far-flung planets waiting for their spaceships to refuel. They will wager at the starbase's casino, barter and sell rare objects, wrangle over intergalactic politics, and attempt to unravel each other’s secret identities. Each player gets a “space passport” containing their cash, Objects, and secrets. When the spacefarers return to their ships, the GM team will collect up the Passports, and examine the contents to determine the overall winner.
Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting A 114 - Looney Labs

Description: New Players welcome! Rules taught, pregen heroes available. No experience needed. The codes to control a top secret military satellite known as High Heaven have been stolen, and a billionaire is poised to buy them on the black market at an astronomical price. High Heavens is an adventure that should take a team of four to five 5th level heroes roughly three to four hours to Play through fully.
Room: Hyatt - 1st Floor - Grant Room- Evil Genius Games

Event Name: DCC RPG Stennard: The Precipice of Corruption
Description:
The town of Stennard sits at the edge of the world. When the crops fail and the "final hope" hunting party goes missing, a horde of townsfolk turned mercenary push into the forbidden lands looking for answers to claim a 10 copper piece reward!

WARNING! Stennard is a grimdark survival-horror setting comparable in tone to The Walking Dead, 28 Days Later, or Mad Max.
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Marion Room

Event Name: Let's Play Mischief at the Museum
Description: Finally satisfy that most basic of human urges: To Cause Mischief at the Museum. Collaboratively build a museum with your friends then compete to have the most memorable day ever! Mischief, Romance, and Friendship are your goals in this hilariously irreverent game for 1-6 players ages 7+
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2430 - 6x30 Tables

Room: Hyatt - 1st Floor - Hayes Room- Lurking Fears

Description: The Teaflingers have gone missing, having been drawn away from Hommlet on one of their ill-advised adventures. Will you dare the ruins of the Temple of Elemental Evil and find the Teaflingers before they disappear into the dungeons below? A 4-hour Legends of Greyhawk Adventure for characters 1st to 4th level.
Room: Hyatt Regency Ballroom - D&D - Baldman Games

Description: A gut-punch of a game that pits two to six players in an epic team battle over a pioneer town. The question is: are you feeling like a pioneer, or a renegade? Do you want to build the town, or burn it down? It is a game drenched in theme--from keeping track of the game rounds by loading bullets into a revolver chamber, to the tongue-in-cheek descriptions on the cards. Strategy and luck take equal roles as you out-shoot, out-gamble and outsmart the other team to victory!
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2104 - Mid Level Meeple

Whispers of ancient pacts and blood feuds echo in the castle halls, and local villagers speak of shadows that move at dusk. The Society must navigate a deadly political web where loyalty is scarce—and the cost of breaking tradition is paid in blood.
Room: Hyatt - 1st Floor - Hayes Room- Lurking Fears

Event Name: Legends of Greyhawk - Wrath of the Blighted Wood
Description: Corruption spreads through the Vesve Forest, and magical wards must be planted to slow the blight’s advance. But the tainted woods are not so easily tamed, and agents of Iuz and an entity only known as the Walking Green stand in your way. Can you sort friend from foe, and salvation from corruption, before the forest is lost - and your lives with it? A Legends of Greyhawk adventure for level 1-4 characters.
Room: Hyatt Regency Ballroom - D&D - Baldman Games

Description: Want the best, and coolest, D&D Experience at the show? This is it. Play with one of our best DM's, in a cool exclusive space, with the same group of players through the entire Legends of Greyhawk Highfolk Tier One experience. This includes Wrath of the Blighted Wood, Beyond the Delven Door, and Chrous of the Storm. The three 4-hour play sessions will be on Thur 7pm, Fri 7pm, and Sat 2pm
Room: Hyatt Regency Ballroom - D&D - Baldman Games

The Lady needs a brave, skilled and trustworthy company to track down the sailor and retrieve the critical information.  Seasoned ranked pc’s provided.

Description: Rock & Roll Brouhaha is a living card game in which players become band managers who are tasked with assembling musicians, buying musical gear, looking for gigs, and scheduling venues for their bands. R&RB has resource management, tableau building, worker placement, lane battling, engine building, and tug-of-war elements. This non-violent, funky, inclusive, and sometimes humorous game features gorgeous, unique artwork. R&RB is medium complexity. Players will be given a game tutorial and provided with pre-constructed decks to play; no prior experience is necessary.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2430 - 6x30 Tables

Description: You're a no-good varmint and a card cheat, so you've brought your own cards to the Saloon. The bad news for you is that everyone else at the table is a cheat, too! You'll have to take some risks and play your cards smart once tempers flare and bullets start to fly!

Room: GCCC - 2nd Floor - Above Reg - Short North Ballroom B

Players are Washington/Cornwallis & their subordinates during the winter of '77. Both sides compete over the same resources needed to conduct military operations; however, players must be careful not to overreach and squander resources required for the summer campaigning season.

To save your people, you’ll need to hire the right workers, balance your resources, and even call upon the magic of mighty wizards! Can you finish the third year with more grain than competing rulers and secure prosperity for your kingdom?
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)

But when a series of disappearances in upstate New York point to a private “wellness academy” with an unusually high security budget, the Secret World’s factions take notice. When an agent's sister goes missing, you are assigned to infiltrate the academy and get her back. Can you survive your first mission as a team? Find out in this Savage Worlds Adventure!

Can you banish the spirit to the netherworld and escape before you become its next victims?

When the dust settles, the scarlet letter shall be no more… and only wrath remains. Characters Provided.

Tonight is sure to be another safe uneventful at at The Speakeasy of Lies

Room: GCCC - 2nd Floor - Meeting Room B #243 - Chicago ConLARP

The piece needed is too complex to build, but perhaps the Offal Mongers – inhuman monks that live inside the burning slopes of the Atrophic Hill – may have a part that can be bargained for. Be wary though, some say the monks are cannibals. Others claim they are egregious necromancers always wanting of a fresh corpse. Whoever they are, there is something deep under that hill they live to venerate - a mystery you're destined to find out.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: Hyatt - 1st Floor - Ohio Center A -

Event Name: The Rule of Cool vs. Rigid Thinking
Description:
This presentation explores the confrontation between flexible imaginative play and rigid adherence to rules and expectations. How do we encourage students to imagine beyond their comfort zone when such spontaneous imaginative leaps conflict with previously understood rules of the system? This presentation will introduce listeners to some examples of supportive language and strategies to help neurodivergent or otherwise inflexible thinkers cope with the discomfort of allowing some unpredictability into their social gaming.
Presenters: Sam Goldberg, LGPC, M.Ed. & Maryanne Cullinan, Ph.D.

Event Name: The Importance of Player Agency in Storytelling Games
Description:
Nina Liu-Guechev LPCC, Jaclyn Lewis, Olivia (Liv) Larbi
Many applied gaming professionals keep RPGs tightly controlled, but empowering players with agency—over characters, story, and world—can greatly enhance outcomes. This panel explores how player choice strengthens therapeutic, educational, and social benefits of TTRPGs. Drawing on experiences across classrooms, justice centers, libraries, and therapy settings, panelists share tools, techniques, and examples to help attendees foster learning, identity work, and collaboration through player-driven play.

The world is a harsh place and sometimes you need to relax and take a few minutes to yourself. The players find themselves at the Midtown Mall either working or as a customer. While you spend your time in the mall of the millennia, strange events occur revealing magic, wonder, and your true identity as you create an Invisible Sun character."

In this game, you'll come face to face with them all as you work together to rid the town of the maniacal or misunderstood creatures. Prizes to all! Rules taught. http://boarsheadgames.com
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2409 - Boar's Head Games

Press your luck black jack style game with fun, dog bone-shaped dice.  Play Rover Roll Over and other fun, quick, competitive family games with Jeff from Pair of Jacks Games
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)

Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Fayette Room- Gahanna Gaming Group

Description:
PREQUEL is a tactical storytelling game of heroic sacrifice. Uncover Tritogenia’s fog mysteries in a communal lore-driven story where you become a hero sacrificing all for a future for others. Discover the mysteries behind the fog, uncover the secrets of the nightmarish enemy forcing all living things to flee, and defeat an evil to save a future you will never see.

Description: Explore the world of Cyberpunk as the hero of your own story, as you help a plucky team of edgerunners dismantle the nefarious Project Cyphon. In this installment, you’ve got 40 minutes to explore a private room inside the premiere night club Second Sight. Your goal? Break into the briefcase of the suit responsible for the Project Cyphon scheme, and secure the prototype for their upcoming tech release before it’s too late!
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting Room B 142 - Roll Your Destiny

Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Morrow Room- Untold Stories Project

Clout is the first and only Collectible Chip Throwing Game.  2026 CLOUT Annual International Championship where the stacks used will be Multi-color Maxi-Stacks (Sepis Keep is banned)  To clarify, each player needs to make a 50 point stack (double the normal) and their stack needs to include at least one chip of every color. Players will build and bring their own 15 'stack' of chips. (We will have some available for new players.)

Relic Wars is a ruthless battle-&-exploration game set in a dark fantasy world, brought to life by the striking medieval-inspired art of Riccardo D’Ariano.
Victory comes from either destroying your rivals or claiming three legendary golden chalices — but the instant the third is taken, every survivor turns hunter. Each turn blends tactical combat, clever spell combinations, and powerful upgrades, while sudden Divine Intervention can shatter even perfect plans.

A reward poster catches your eye. It’s from one of the most prominent saloon girls of “Madame Vyzotsky’s Palace”. The girl claims the task is quite simple: retrieve an item left behind in an abandoned settlement, the loss of which has rendered the girl’s beloved niece utterly inconsolable. The new ShadowWest RPG brings you weird west dark fantasy action using the fast and easy Shadowdark rules.  Run by contributor and editor Ari Bowie of Fox and Boar Games!

Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2300 - Allplay Games

In this psychological horror one-shot, you play patients inside a psychiatric facility where reality bends under the weight of memory and guilt. When a door that wasn't there yesterday suddendly appears, the truth becomes unstable. Each character sees something different, and no one agrees on what is real.

This session focuses on investigation, character-driven choices, and surreal storytelling rather than combat. No prior knowledge of the system is required.
Room: Hyatt - Clark Rooms Foyer

Description:
A simple dungeon crawl using modern rules but played in an old school style. Low level fun with a DM who has played the game for 50 years. 
We will use home made dungeon tiles and wooden counters for people and monsters.
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Knox Room

Description: JollyLand, everyone's favorite asteroid amusement park, has been taken by pirates! Unluckily for them, JollyLand has backup security. Play as a terrifying Animatronic in this space fantasy horror game! A 5e (2024) adventure for level 6 heroes. Pregen heroes available.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: Hyatt - 1st Floor - Ohio Center A -

Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: Hyatt - 1st Floor - Ohio Center A -

First, they are the guides in rival tour companies; they must make up four short (2-3 minute) stories for their tour based on story element cards they are given.  Second, they are tourists taking the other players' tours; they tip their tour guides based on how well they liked the tour (you must give away all of your tip money and cannot tip yourself).  The guide who earns the most tips wins.  About one-and-a-half hours play time.
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2530 - Rounds

Premade character sheets available.

Secure the most treasure, and win the game!

Description: California 1934. Your survey team has a three-day layover waiting for your train back east. While checking into the hotel, you hear a rumor about a gentleman looking for people to join his treasure hunting team. Doesn’t hurt to listen. Call of Cthulhu 7e. Pre-generated characters provided. Scenario is horror based and includes death, gore, etc.
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Franklin A Room- Matinee Adventures

Take on the roles of Pilgrims condemned to scrounge for resources outside the protection of their city-states. Use the highly adaptable Grit System to explore, and survive, a shattered world packed with historical fantasy, religio-political intrigue, and brutal combat. No previous experience or knowledge of history required.

Description: Take the role of the most feared mercenaries across the galaxy - humans. Garrisoning a small freighter - the ship is boarded by synthetic capeks pirates while in the warp. You must fend them off with guns, grenades, swords, and sheer human tenacity. All just to get paid and keep flying.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)

If the inspector or his cadaver dog are digging into your hole… Whack him with a shovel and add him to the hole before he can expose your victims. Plays like uno with some major, dark twists.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)

Things get tense in the domes when famed cryptid hunter Nimrod makes his way to The Moon. Will he uncover something on the surface? Or is this a reality TV show ploy?

In the game, you’ll play as one of six specialized classes (Baker, Drifter, Prepper, Trucker, Lawyer, or Nurse Practitioner) and work with your party of travelers to navigate a postapocalyptic landscape. If you love creative combat, collaborative problem-solving, a little bit of weirdo grime,  and jokes that take themselves just seriously enough, WAFFLE US is for you.

Mahjong is a tile game focused on set collection with many variants. It is similar in many ways to card games like Gin Rummy where players race to complete valid hands containing sequences and triplets.

Strategy and luck take equal roles as you out-shoot, out-gamble and outsmart the other team to victory!

Why did he take the route he did, through the Wilderness, Spotsylvania and Cold Harbor?

Participants will explore how prioritizing story over mechanics and accessibility over strict rules can increase agency, inclusion, and psychological safety, while learning practical strategies for collaborative, player‑centered play.

(Smartphone required to use class abilities)

Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting A #112 - Adventure Room Creations

Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2508 - Broken Leg Gamers

At end of game, players snake draft from a prize pool consisting of all the figures/game elements from the booster packs and added HeroClix Convention Exclusive Limited Edition figures. Individual player performance tracked throughout Origins. Top ranked players qualify for Sunday Championship playoff table!
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2400 - WizKids

Play for an hour or play all conventions long with multiple tables and GMs. Build your character at the Limithron booth, or use a pregen, then hit the Dead Islands! Want to play multiple times throughout the convention? Your character will be back at the tavern, ready to continue when you return.
Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting B 130 - Limithron & Vast Grimm

You'll have the chance to experience new character options like firearms and Allomancy, race through the streets of Elendel, and carry out a daring heist! Just bring some dice and a pencil; we'll provide pre-generated characters.
Room: Hyatt - 1st Floor - Hayes Room- Lurking Fears

Description:
LNTE04: Something in Sheep’s Clothing
Caravans traveling the roads outside Lanthe have reported strange disturbances in the night, and livestock shipments have become frequent targets. Merchants are offering coin to anyone willing to patrol the trade routes and uncover what is stalking the caravans. Will you protect the roads and discover what truly lurks beyond the city’s watchful walls? An adventure for 1st through 4th level players, based on the Bestselling "Chaos Seeds" books by Dr. Aleron Kong. New Players Welcome, we will teach rules at the table. All materials provided.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: Hyatt - 1st Floor - Harrison - The Land: Roleplaying System

Description: The crew are among the winners of the system lottery granting them first access to the vessel’s Deck 5, racing against other scavenger teams to strip it of its treasures. Deck 5: The Agrideck suffered catastrophic radiation exposure during the disappearance of the War Done.
Room: Hyatt - 1st Floor - Hayes Room- Lurking Fears

Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2318 - NCG

Event Name: LNTE05: The Wolf at the Wall
Description:
LNTE05: The Wolf at the Wall
City guards have reported unusual animal behavior along the outer walls of Lanthe, raising concern that something unnatural may be lurking nearby. Adventurers are needed to patrol the perimeter and investigate the strange sightings before they become a greater threat. What begins as a simple watch may reveal far more than anyone expected. An adventure for 1st through 4th level players, based on the Bestselling "Chaos Seeds" books by Dr. Aleron Kong. New Players Welcome, we will teach rules at the table. All materials provided.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: Hyatt - 1st Floor - Harrison - The Land: Roleplaying System

Description: Rescue as many cats as you can before Lord Vesh comes to destroy their home.
Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting Room B #131 - Rogue Judges

Description: 7 September 1695. Captain Henry Avery, the “King of Pirates,” led a daring raid on a Grand Mughal treasure convoy bound for Mecca, escaping with over £600,000 in plunder. His crime sparked the first worldwide manhunt in history. By 1696, Avery and his treasure vanished, presumed lost. Rumors persist that the haul included Poseidon’s Trident, a relic said to grant power over the seas. You are the crew of the Iron Grackle, racing the East India Company to Avery’s last known hideaway to uncover the truth and claim the prize. This is a multi-table event with cross-table play telling a shared story
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Knox Room

Description: The Paranormal/Occult Research Center (PORC) has asked your team to investigate the death of a famous medium. During that investigation, you have become trapped by, what seems to be, the same malevolent spirit that killed the medium. Can you banish the spirit to the netherworld and escape before you become its next victims?
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - 2nd Floor - Meeting Room B #242 - Chicago ConLARP

Event Name: Artemis Spaceship Bridge Simulator - Cosmos Edition!
Description: Join five of your friends or complete strangers as you take control of a spaceship bridge. Whether you voyage with old friends or soon to be new friends, this will be one of the most enjoyable team-building experiences that you have ever had. This popular annual event will be using the latest version of Artemis Cosmos.
Room: GCCC - 2nd Floor - Meeting B 241 - GamingNomads

Description: Explore all 63 US national parks in this causal set collecting card game that balances building your own sets of national parks while strategically delaying others. The deisgner Jason Wong spent 3 years traveling to all 63 US national parks and created a mahjong-inspired card game that features all his own photography.
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2430 - 6x30 Tables

Event Name: Titan City: Silverthorne Academy Second Class Pt 3
Description: A three part miniseries where you will create your own magical or monstrous student of the Titan City Silverthorne Academy using the new 4th Edition Mutants & Masterminds rules! Will feature some precon prep to create your character, order art, create a custom miniature, and co-create a bespoke adventure experience with the line developer of Mutants & Masterminds. The goal is to have the same players for all three parts, so please intend to play all parts. Will coordinate precon prep through Discord.
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Morrow Room- Untold Stories Project

Description: Try the party game that's always a blast. Find your teammates, establish trust, and exchange hostages before time runs out and the bomb explodes!
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - 2nd Floor - Above Reg - Short North Ballroom Foyer

Room: GCCC - 2nd Floor - Above Reg - Short North Ballroom B

Description:
Come try & win a laser etched wood box insert in our tournament. The semi final will be on Saturday at 2:00 PM. The final will be on Saturday at 8:00 PM.
A fast-paced & addictive game of gem collecting & card development. Players are merchants of the Renaissance trying to buy gem mines with means of transportation and shops all in order to acquire the most prestige points. You might even receive a visit from a noble at some point that will further increase your prestige.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2322 - Rising Phoenix Gaming Club

Description: You've seen The Boys and how the "Supes" manage to save the day. But, you've also seen that it doesn't always go as cleanly as it should. You get to play as the "Supes" as you spend your average day saving the civilians from certain death and keeping those pesky Boys from exposing your PR mishaps. So suit up! Get out there and show the world that you are The Seven and you are the hero! Or show them that you can do whatever the $^%& you want! But we must warn you, if you've seen the show, you know that this is not a kids game, so there will be no censoring!  Adults only.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2318 - NCG

Description: This is for folks who want to play a game with other experienced players. Players who sign up for this event should be very comfortable with the following: valid yaku (we have reference sheets), game flow, calls (Chii, Pon, Kan, Ron). You do NOT have to be fluent in scoring manually (we can help with that), and we are happy to teach players how to handle the tiles (if you have only played on an online client). Players should be ready to take less than 5 seconds for most turns to ensure that a full game can fit into the time slot we’ve reserved.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2534 - Rounds

Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2526 - 8x30

Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting Room B 144 - Stronghold LARP Foam

Event Name: PFS2 #7-14 Brastlewark at War, Part 2: The Gnome Liberation
Description: (Levels 3-4) The gnomes of Brastlewark were being forced to construct a magical weapon of war. The Andoran army is going to assault the production facilities, but it's up to the Pathfinders to see that the citizens can be safe and free.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Franklin B-D Rooms- Ohio Organized Play

Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2518 - ProtoCLE

Description: Ticket to Ride is a cross-country train adventure in which players collect and play matching train cards to claim railway routes connecting cities throughout North America. The longer the routes, the more points they earn. Additional points come to those who can fulfill their Destination Tickets by connecting two distant cities, and to the player who builds the longest continuous railway.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2322 - Rising Phoenix Gaming Club

Description: Return to Night City in the official co-op, story-driven Cyberpunk card game where your crew and choices shape every run. Be among the first to play before it hits stores.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2200 - Night Crew Games

Event Name: Raptors: Cold War 3D Jet Air Combat
Description: The Cold War has turned hot.  The Warsaw Pact is storming into the Fulda Gap.  The NATO alliance stands defiantly against them.  Take to the skies and fight for air superiority in an easy to learn 3D environment.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2334 - Minis Tables

Description: In Feed the Kraken, all players may be sitting in the same boat, but they want to navigate in different directions. Loyal sailors must bring the ship safely to land, whereas pirates crave to secretly maneuver the ship into the Bermuda Triangle. Meanwhile, a cultist works to convince the crew to help them summon the Kraken from the depth of the sea. Convince the crew to make you the next lieutenant or navigator, or draw your guns and take over as captain! But for how long will you be able to keep the trust of your crew? The next mutiny might already be waiting for you.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - 2nd Floor - Above Reg - Short North Ballroom B

Event Name: Blood on the Clocktower: Sects & Violets
Description: [Intermediate] Jump into a new version of Blood on the Clocktower. After you've tried Trouble Brewing try one of the intermediate scripts included in the base game. Our Storytellers will explain changes and answer questions, however prior knowledge of the rules is required.
Room: GCCC - 2nd Floor - Above Reg - Short North Ballroom B

Description: Play and Learn with Game Creator! -unique 7d12 system- Roleplay angels fighting evil spirits and guiding humans. Spiritual-Fantasy gameplay of biblical proportions.
Room: Hyatt - 1st Floor - Ohio Center A -

Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)

Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2518 - ProtoCLE

Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2300 - Allplay Games

Can you figure out how to get them back into their cages before the spell wears off and the beasts are released into the realm?
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - 2nd Floor - Meeting Room B #243 - Chicago ConLARP

Description: The mysterious Scrolls of Membership keep the roster of the guild for the Guildmaster of the Night. Each member's truename ties their life to the Scrolls and removing a name from the Scrolls kills the guild member. Can you recover the Scrolls before your enemies?
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - 2nd Floor - Meeting Room B #244 - Chicago ConLARP

Description: Your gang has been tailing the outlaw Cyrus O'Rourke for over a week. His posse is responsible for crimes including murder and robbery in 3 states. The bounty is high. But the danger mounts as his kills look stranger and stranger. He seems to be on a new mission. Can you bring him in dead or alive? The new ShadowWest RPG brings you weird west dark fantasy action using the fast and easy ShadowDark rules. Run by author and Designer John Harford.
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Marion Room

Description: (Levels 7-8) Within the ocean, an ancient temple reemerges and the Pathfinders will need to explore as quick as they can before the ocean reclaims its bounty!  NEED A VALID PFS CHARACTER, no pregens available.

Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Franklin B-D Rooms- Ohio Organized Play

Description: Take on the roles of investigators attempting to solve a murder case – but there's a twist. The killer is one of the investigators! Each player's role and team are randomly assigned at the start of play and include the unique roles of Forensic Scientist, Witness, Investigator, Murderer, and Accomplice. While the Investigators attempt to deduce the truth, the murderer's team must deceive and mislead.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Fayette Room- Gahanna Gaming Group

Description: Attention, Troubleshooters! The Computer presents a glorious mission to cleanse Alpha Complex of unauthorized markings. Join fellow loyal citizens in this vital endeavor to restore order and harmony. Remember, any deviation from protocol will be met with swift corrective action. Have fun, loyal citizens!
Room: Hyatt - 1st Floor - Hayes Room- Lurking Fears

Description:
The village of Estwall celebrates harvest each year with a bonfire to beat back the homespun Autumn clouds. It is a masked celebration, awash with hard cider and carelessness. Lovers quarrel, the town council debates…and mysterious cloaked figures sharpen knives in fire-cast shadows. Watch out for those knives.
Masquerade Ball is a social deduction/diplomacy game in development. Every game is played using a unique scenario. You never know what might happen at the ball—or which lies might be told.  Note: standing and walking will be required!
Room: GCCC - 2nd Floor - Above Reg - Short North Ballroom B

Room: Hyatt - 1st Floor - Hayes Room- Lurking Fears

The experiment was left behind in the evacuation. You've got a metal cage about the size of a shoebox; how bad can this be? A Cyberpunk RED adventure for six hearty party members.

Description:
The Origins Awards return in full force, celebrating the best and brightest in tabletop gaming. This year, your guide through the glitz, glory, and glorious chaos is none other than Travis McElroy!

Expect sharp wit, unexpected moments, and a night packed with industry legends, rising stars, and the games that defined the year. From heartfelt acceptance speeches to perfectly timed jokes (and maybe a few delightful derailments), this is where the tabletop world comes to celebrate history being made!

The players fight jealous gods and cruel tyrants for the right to live, and they’re constantly deciding between giving each other their hearts or ascending to monstrous, godlike power.

INTR03: Burden of Proof
You have found refuge in an old barn, surrounded by creaking walls and rusted tools. As the barn doors open, light floods the room, revealing a gruesome sight you had not seen in the darkness—and villagers blaming you for the carnage. Can you prove your innocence, or did you commit this act of violence? A roleplay-intensive adventure for those wishing to try The Land: Roleplaying System, based on the bestselling Chaos Seeds books by Dr. Aleron Kong. Break into the briefcase of the suit responsible for the Project Cyphon scheme, and secure the prototype for their upcoming tech release before it’s too late!

Lord of the Rings 5E - Join GM Sam to learn how to play Free League's rendition of The Lord of the Rings Roleplaying game.

Description:
There is alarm among the Ice Forgers at those levels of the Dwarvenarium where stone meets frozen ice. The deep forges of the Hot Lava Elves have struck a new magma flow, threatening to liquify the glacier and steam clean the entire mountain. Your retinue of burly and bearded Dwarven is sent to mitigate disaster and deal with any fiery horrors from this vaporous sauna. 


6th level characters provided. Highly experienced DM, hand-drawn illustrations, very nice prizes, awesome custom aesthetics, playtester credits.

Description: Crack the vault, grab the cash, and get to the hideout alive!  Learn to play this exciting new social deduction game!  No early eliminations and an explosive action phase set Bank Heist apart in the genre of social deception.

Room: GCCC - 2nd Floor - Above Reg - Short North Ballroom B

Description:
LNTE01: Unpleasant Produce
Fresh produce across Lanthe’s farmer’s market has begun rotting overnight, threatening both merchants’ livelihoods and the city’s food supply. You have been hired to investigate the mysterious spoilage and stop panic from spreading throughout the city. Will you discover the foul source of this corruption before it spreads through Lanthe? An adventure for 1st through 4th level players, based on the Bestselling "Chaos Seeds" books by Dr. Aleron Kong. New Players Welcome, we will teach rules at the table. All materials provided.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: Hyatt - 1st Floor - Harrison - The Land: Roleplaying System

Using your resources, you will take control of key areas in the city of Jerusalem: the King's Palace, Patriarchy, Market, Templar, Nobility, and Tower of David.  The areas you control provide you with resources to expand your power in the city: men, gold, and prestige. Out of Thyme is a real-time cooperative survival game where you and your team race a relentless countdown to complete a mission on Pluto. You’ll explore a shifting map, respond to escalating threats, and decide on the teams decisions together. Every choice matters, every second counts, and success depends on how well your team adapts under pressure in this tense, replayable sci-fi experience.

You’ll be learning and playing alongside the designer, with opportunities to share feedback on the rulebook, balance, and overall experience. The game takes ab
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2430 - 6x30 Tables

In The Hunger Within the Web, players explore a dark fantasy scenario set within a vast, living web that has overtaken part of an ancient wood elf forest. Survival, exploration, and tactical combat take center stage as the party navigates dangerous terrain, hunts twisted creatures, and uncovers the source of the corruption before it spreads further.

What begins as a night of celebration quickly descends into chaos, forcing a small group of heroes to rely on their courage, wit, and each other to survive. Cut off from help and facing impossible odds, the only way out is to stand and fight.

In this family-friendly D&D session, kids will explore, solve problems, and roleplay their way through a cooperative story designed just for them. Rules are taught as we play, with an emphasis on creativity, teamwork, and fun—not numbers or complexity.
No experience required. Pregenerated characters provided.
This is a continued 3 part story. Though it can be played as a one shot.
Age Range: Kids Only (12 and under. Must be with an adult)
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Union D - The Motley Kids Family Room

Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Union D - The Motley Kids Family Room

Description: Explore the world of Cyberpunk as the hero of your own story, as you help a plucky team of edgerunners dismantle the nefarious Project Cyphon. In this installment, you’ve got 40 minutes to explore a private room inside the premiere night club Second Sight. Your goal? Break into the briefcase of the suit responsible for the Project Cyphon scheme, and secure the prototype for their upcoming tech release before it’s too late!
