Description: Players will be taught the rules to Thunder Road Vendetta and able to play through a full game. All materials provided.
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting A 120 - Restoration Games

Description: Back by popular demand! Play this great board game in large scale! Build and manage a farm in 17th century Europe, with crops, livestock, buildings, improvements, and more. Each player board is the size of a table, with room to build your house, plow your fields, and fence your pastures. Prizes!
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2409 - Boar's Head Games

Description:
Each player holds 3 cards & on a turn a player draws 1 card, then plays 1 card. By playing cards, you can put new rules into play that change numerous aspects of the game: how many cards to draw or play. Choose from over 20 possible decks brought by the GMs. Pirate, Zombie, Monty, Python, Marvel, Basic, & more.

GMs will be running two simultaneous session with up to 4 players in each.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2409 - Boar's Head Games

Description:
Monsters are attacking the town, and kid detectives known as the Creeps have to figure out which ones they can trap! Only the monsters with the most cards under them will score, but you also need those same monster cards in your hand to get points, so you have to decide when to play a monster card and when to keep it in your hand.

With The Creeps: The Monster-Trapping Game, you can play the "family game" for quicker games and younger audiences, or play the "full game" for asymmetric powers, game-changing trap cards, and more strategic scoring options.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2430 - 6x30 Tables

Description: Adventure into the woods to forage truffles and other edible plants. You will have to decide to either sale them to the market immediately or ice them for later rounds for potentially greater value.
Room: GCCC - Exhibit Hall Booth - #2219 - B.A. Games

Description: This game is a miniatures-based combined-arms mass-combat game that uses all the units you know from Battletech. It is designed to let you play larger scale battles in a few hours or a smaller game much quicker. It is also miniatures-based, which means the board is not hexed like in classic Battletech and instead miniatures rules are used.  This event will teach all of the basics of the game system so you can then feel confident to play on your own or in our other Alpha Strike events.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2304 - Catalyst Game Labs

Description:
D&D Workshop: Professional-Level Storytelling for Table and Screen
Two hours. B. Dave Walters teaches you the fundamentals that separate a good session from a legendary one. Whether you're chasing an actual-play career or simply want to shock and awe the players at your table, the technique is the same — and it's learnable. We'll cover how to build tension, command a scene, and take an audience somewhere they didn't know they could go. You bring the desire; I'll give you the tools to play in the majors.
Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting Room A 113 - B. Dave Walters

Description: For first time TTR players or experienced players seeking a more challenging game, Rails & Sails lets you to fulfill destinations by building routes via both train and ship. European map and Great Lakes map available. Prizes for All. http://boarsheadgames.com/
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2409 - Boar's Head Games

Description: Learn the world's favorite superhero game in under an hour! ALL participants will receive BOTH complete HeroClix Starter Sets (MSRP $39.99ea)!
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2400 - WizKids

Description: A ship this big is worth fighting over. Awesome piratey shipboard mayhem in 54 mm!
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2420 - Ottawa Red Shirts

Description:
The Expanse RPG is a rules-lite system that moves fast and is easy to play.  The setting is science fiction and the objective is to find a missing person, with a different scenario each day this weekend.

Combat moves fast and can quickly get deadly. So use your words instead of your fists, stay focused on the mission, and maybe you'll pull it off!

You won't need to bring anything.  Character sheets, dice, and pencils will all be provided.  Look forward to seeing you there!
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2522 - Central Ohio TI4

Description:
MIND MGMT: The Psychic Espionage “Game” is a one-versus-many, hidden-movement game about a top-secret organization that uses psychic spies to alter world events.

One player is the Recruiter for MIND MGMT who must race around Zanzibar in an attempt to collect enough new recruits to win.

All the other players are Rogue Agents who used to work for MIND MGMT, but now are trying to take it down from the outside. If they can deduce and pinpoint the exact location of the Recruiter they win!
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2430 - 6x30 Tables

Description:
The Bushelbearer farm is being harassed by strange creatures from the woods.  Can you protect the farm and family from the Wide Eyed Terror?
This session will be a funnel scenario with multiple 0-level peasants.
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2534 - Rounds

Event Name: FIND THE FUNNY, An RPG Improv Workshop
Description:
You're already funny, we promise! Join acclaimed improvisers Amy Vorpahl and Dave Hill for a playful workshop that organically explores your real sense of humor at the gaming table. No improv experience needed—just bring yourself!

Through  interactive exercises, discover how to tap into your unique point of view, sharpen your observation skills, and embrace your delightful way of being in fun moments. This supportive, judgment-free environment celebrates what makes you funny. You'll leave with practical skills to create fun, organic gameplay for everyone at your table.
Room: GCCC - 2nd Floor - Meeting B #230 - Free Movement

Event Name: Hidden Heroes of the Awakened Woods
Description: Experience a different perspective as you play a small animal trying to save their friends and the unique place they call home. The Awakened Woods that these animals inhabit is a sanctuary to non-predatory animals... until one day everything changes unexpectedly as a fox walks in.
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting Room - A #111 - TTRPGs

Description: Wizard Miners is a lighthearted race to riches where wizards use drills, dynamite, and spells to dig through their mines faster than their rivals. Players upgrade tools, blast rock, sabotage opponents, and manage the risk of cave-ins as they race to clear their deck first. Fast-paced and approachable with just enough strategy and chaos to keep things lively. All players receive a free wizard hat for playing.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2526 - 8x30

Description:
Star Gambit is a tactical 1v1 space battle. Learn to command your spaceships to victory in this beginner-friendly experience. 
Will you annihilate the enemy fleet or destroy their portal?
Try the digital tutorial at https://play.stargamb.it/tutorial

By Hex Theory, a two-man studio building games and community since 2024.
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2526 - 8x30

Description: Become the most popular conspiracy podcaster by connecting the dots, gaining evidence and proving conspiracies to gain new subscribers. As you move around the board you leave breadcrumbs of evidence for other players to find. Gain followers as other players talk about your conspiracies.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2518 - ProtoCLE

Event Name: The Networks: Primetime - Learn to Play
Description: You are running a new television network and need new programming. For this, you'll need Shows, Stars, and Ads. The player with the most viewers after five seasons wins!
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2300 - Allplay Games

Description: On November 4, 1955, a man arrived at London Airport with a passport from a nation that does not exist. British authorities decided to investigate and put the mystery man up in a hotel. By morning, he was gone. Was he a spy? A time traveler? Now, a team of paranormal investigators from the Hopewell Institute are tasked with answering those questions and finding the Man from Nowhere.
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Champaign Room

Description: Come try & win a laser etched wood box insert in our tournament. The Final will include the expansions New Buildings and The Nobles. The final will be on Saturday at 6:00 PM. The players are plantation owners in the days when ships had sails. By growing up to five different kind of crops, corn, indigo, sugar, tobacco, and coffee. They try to run their business more efficiently than their close competitors: growing crops and storing them efficiently, developing San Juan with useful buildings, deploying their colonists to best effect, selling crops at the right time, and sailing ships.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2322 - Rising Phoenix Gaming Club

Description: An engine-building game about planning and efficiency. Buy gears, produce mana, and complete orders to become the gnome with the most renown!
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2526 - 8x30

Description: Matinee Adventures Presents:  5-Minute Dungeon -  You and your party of intrepid heroes are trapped in a series of 5 deadly dungeons. To survive, you must battle together against dangerous monsters, obstacles and Dungeon Bosses. Defeat each dungeon in 5 minutes or less, and you win!
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Franklin A Room- Matinee Adventures

Description: Romance, befriend, and SLAY a dungeon full of monsters! Build a stylish adventuring outfit, then use your style to match the interests of fantasy monsters. Features set collection, tableau-building, and loads of cute, silly monster cards. Simultaneous action selection keeps the game moving quickly and your opponents guessing!
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2430 - 6x30 Tables

Event Name: Kebab: The Board Game on A Stick
Description: A delicious drafting and pattern building game for 2-6 players. Assemble you kebab to please your hungry guests, where the players create the scoring conditions. Each game takes 20 minutes or less and will leave you hungry for more.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2434 - 6x30 Tables

Event Name: Primordial Secrets - Eldritch Deck Building Game
Description: Secret action selection, simultaneous play, big reveals, and multiple paths to victory elevate this interactive deck building game into something more... cosmic. After much delay, this award-winning game has finally gotten a reprint!
Room: GCCC - Exhibit Hall Booth - #1219 - GL HF Games

Event Name: Recruiting Crew: Roll a Pirate Borg Character
Description: Become part of the crew! Enter the pirate ship at the Limithron booth, sit at the captain’s table, and create your very own wretched soul with the help of a seasoned harbourmaster. You'll be generating a character, then learning the basic rules. Afterwards, take your pirate and join the convention-long "Plunder the Dead Islands" event or a full adventure! (sign-up separately)
Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting B 130 - Limithron & Vast Grimm

Event Name: Project Cyphon - The Flaw in the System
Description: Explore the world of Cyberpunk as the hero of your own story, as you help a plucky team of edgerunners dismantle the nefarious Project Cyphon. In this installment, you’ll explore the convention center to locate terminals installed by Braindance Inc. There, you’ll meet inhabitants of Night City who will help you hack these terminals and take down Project Cyphon’s insidious BDL network for good.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting Room B 142 - Roll Your Destiny

Description: 14ers is a quick tableau-building card game where you will take turns adding one “Climb card,” each representing a different 14er, to your Hiker by tucking the Climb card under one of the four sides of your Hiker card to reveal a specific ability they can now use for the rest of the game. These abilities can either help you gain more difficult and powerful Climb cards or score points at the end of the game.
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Exhibit Hall Booth - #2505 - Pocket Parks

Event Name: Shackleton Series: Episode 1 - Interactive Puzzle Adventure
Description: The Shackleton Series is a 6-episode tabletop escape game. The storyline follows the true account of how 28 men got trapped off the coast of Antartica for 2 years, and everyone made it home alive. In this session you'll play the first episode in the series hosted by one of the designers of the game, Eric Reynolds or Paul Harvey. Each episode is packed with recreations of beautiful artifacts from the expedition. Players work together as a team to find clues, and solve puzzles as they explore the remarkable story of how Shackleton and his crew managed to escape from Antarctica.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Exhibit Hall Booth - #2409 - Escape Mail

Event Name: Project Cyphon - The Writing on the Walls
Description: Explore the world of Cyberpunk as the hero of your own story, as you help a plucky team of edgerunners dismantle the nefarious Project Cyphon. In this installment, you’ll travel the vendor hall, visiting booths to collect graffiti left by the mysterious Astaire. Collect them all to find a hidden message and unmask the identity of a treacherous ripperdoc!
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting Room B 142 - Roll Your Destiny
Space: Event; Event 11; Event 6; Event 7; Event 12; Event 8; Event 9

Description: We are back for yet another amazing year! Come build & take home a 3ft safe LARP cloth covered foam sword that can last for years. Generics always welcome. Come anytime to our area that we are open "10 - 5" to build!
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting Room B 144 - Stronghold LARP Foam

Description: A stand-alone 2-player game based on the hit deduction game, Corps of Discovery. In this game, you and your partner are placing tiles to create a map by following logic rules!
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2430 - 6x30 Tables

Description: Earn points and command woodland creatures by having the most birds on a location, pushing your foes off the perch, and breaking ties to take the lead. Each round, players add their birds into a shared bag. Players then draw birds of their own, and other players take turns stacking birds on location tiles. Each location tile with different points and powers. The game ends after five rounds, and the player who has earned the most points wins.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2434 - 6x30 Tables

Description: Earth, the award-winning Tableau Builder expanded with greater player interaction, new mechanics for card sourcing, and a plethora of new cards. Check out and play the Abundance Expansion!
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2434 - 6x30 Tables

Description: A quick, fun card game of discovering lost goats and treasures as you search an unstable cave. Be careful though. Get too greedy and you may lose it all!
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Exhibit Hall Booth - #2219 - B.A. Games

Description: Can you claim the spot as top Master Chief? Halo Flashpoint: Master Chief Challenge is your chance to face off as one of four Master Chief against 3 other players in a game of Slayer to determine who is THE Master Chief. Bring your painted Master Chief or choose one of ours to take on all comers and see who can rack up the most kills!
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Exhibit Hall Booth - #1016 - Mantic Games

Event Name: FluentSea, UPCOMING RELEASE Learn and Play!
Description:
Coming to Kickstarter Fall of 2026, FluentSea is a word-building, reef-restoration game where every word you make brings a bleached coral reef back to life. You build the best word you can each round, and the longer the word, the more marine species you get to place—like octopus, coral, clownfish, and schooling fish. Each species scores differently based on real behaviors, so clever wordplay and smart ecology both matter. Heal the reef, build the ecosystem, and score the most points to win.

Designed by David Gordon, Travis Magrum and Jon Glimour-Long with development by Leonie Grundler.
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: Lioness Games  - Exhibit Hall Booth 2605

Description: A nature themed tableau builder for 1-4 players. Raise, feed, and protect baby animals! Activate unique flora and fauna abilities. Achieve biodiversity!
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: Lioness Games  - Exhibit Hall Booth 2605

Description: Using raw edged applique you will pick fabric pieces to create a background and dragon of your choice. After assembling, you will be shown ways of finishing off your piece including optional hand sewing. Learn how to add embellishments to make your art piece pop. All materials provided are yours to keep including needle and scissors. If you would like to choose your color of dragon please email toni@quiltoni.com by June 1. After this date you are able to choose from available kits in class. Look at all available Craft Hacker classes at http://www.crafthackers.com/origins/.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Union Station Ballroom C - Sewing & Craft Workshops

Description: We are back for yet another amazing year! Come build & take home a safe foam LARP Weapon! It can last for years of use. This class is for anything but the 3ft sword. Axes, Hammers, Spears, Long Swords, Anime Swords, ETC. Generics always welcome. You can come to our area anytime between 10-5 any day.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting Room B 144 - Stronghold LARP Foam

Event Name: Marvel Mutiverse RPG: Avengers -Scarlet Letter NO More
Description: WHAT IF: X-Tinction Agenda triggered Magneto's Wrath? Part 1: The grand opening of the Museum of Avengers History was meant to be a triumph. Instead, a sudden chain of chaos shatters the celebration—leaving the Avengers gutted by a loss that cuts to their core. When the dust settles, the scarlet letter shall be no more… and only wrath remains. Characters Provided.
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Delaware A-D Rooms- The Gathering

Description: Band together with up to three other players and strive  to survive the nefarious Tomb of Horrors! Use our Custom Character Kit to create your own Onslaught Character and play in a cooperative delve through the randomly generated dungeon, full of peril and challenge on a custom board made from Warlock tiles!
Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting C 162 - WizKids

Description: Quantum Cats is a physics-themed board game where players navigate multiple timelines to ensure their feline figures remain in the Alive state. Participants manage a hand of action cards—such as String Theory and Entanglement—to move their cats across a board featuring wormholes and quantum tunnels. The core gameplay revolves around tactical positioning and state manipulation, as players push opponents or link their own pieces’ fates through quantum mechanics. Victory is achieved by having the most living cats inside the box spaces once the game concludes.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2430 - 6x30 Tables

Event Name: Aerodrome(R) Space 1.0 - Star Wars Fighter Combat
Description: Rebel X-Wings and Imperial Tie space fighters from the Star Wars universe duel in space. This is an advanced playtest game of an exciting new, draft space fighter combat ruleset - Aerodrome(R) Space 1.0 - an adaptation of the popular Aerodrome(R) 1.1 WW1 ruleset, using the same, familiar Aerodrome(R) Wooden Control Panels. Still easy to learn, easy to play, lots of fun. Rules taught, charts and X-Wing/Tie fighter models provided. Awards for Victories and Valor. Spouse and Female Friendly Game. Under age 13 only with playing adult, prior experience or GM permission.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2418 - Aerodrome Aerial Combat

Event Name: Tales of the Arthurian Knights Guided Playthrough
Description: Adventure through Arthurian realms at the height of glory! Encounter legendary people, places, and events! Share and role-play the many epic stories you experience! In this session you will play a quick game through one age, giving you a great taste of the adventure ahead!
Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting C 162 - WizKids

Description: The fastest Legacy game. 2-player legacy deck-building duel. BFFs learn magic by hurling spells at each other. Open envelopes as you play to add content. Time for 1-2 games.
Room: GCCC - Exhibit Hall Booth - #2504 - Indie Games Collective

Event Name: Blood on the Clocktower: Bad Moon Rising
Description: [Intermediate] Jump into a new version of Blood on the Clocktower. After you've tried Trouble Brewing try one of the intermediate scripts included in the base game. Our Storytellers will explain changes and answer questions, however prior knowledge of the rules is required.
Room: GCCC - 2nd Floor - Above Reg - Short North Ballroom B

Event Name: Artemis Spaceship Bridge Simulator - Cosmos Edition!
Description: Join five of your friends or complete strangers as you take control of a spaceship bridge. Whether you voyage with old friends or soon to be new friends, this will be one of the most enjoyable team-building experiences that you have ever had. This popular annual event will be using the latest version of Artemis Cosmos.
Room: GCCC - 2nd Floor - Meeting Room B #245 - GamingNomads

Description: Learn to play Deadzone on this oversized board with giant miniatures.  Deadzone is a skirmish level head-to-head science fiction miniatures game.  You control an elite team of soldiers ready to enter the potentially lethal Deadzone and scavenge for whatever lucrative resources you can find. Get in, get out, get rich, or get dead.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)

Description: For an age, the tower lay in ruins. Unbeknownst to the people of the realm, a great evil stirred in its bowels. It started with strange sightings: a flock of crows flying in circles until they dropped from the sky, the lake frozen solid in the height of summer. Players will gather resources, cleanse buildings, defeat monsters, and undertake quests to build up their strength and discern what foe ultimately awaits them. When the heroes face the tower, the game shifts into its dramatic second act, where the players have one chance to defeat the enemy once and for all.
Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting D 180-D 183 Pride Gamers

Description: Build factories, produce containers, set prices, negotiate with your rivals, and sail across the sea to trade. Obviously, buy low, sell high. But, can you make it happen?
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2300 - Allplay Games

Description: Explore all 63 US national parks in this causal set collecting card game that balances building your own sets of national parks while strategically delaying others. The deisgner Jason Wong spent 3 years traveling to all 63 US national parks and created a mahjong-inspired card game that features all his own photography.
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)

Description: Stop in any time and make a craft! Saturday's crafts are: Mini Painting, Tiny Terrariums, Gnome Hats, Pirate Vessels, DIY UFOs, and Mini Monsters
Age Range: Kids Only (12 and under. Must be with an adult)
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Union D - The Motley Kids Family Room

Description:
Welcome to The Spiral
For centuries, it has tempted adventurers and explorers, eager to claim its untold riches. But, after countless attempts and expeditions, none who have entered this cursed land have returned. 
Nonetheless, you and your crew are determined to get the treasure. 
But in The Spiral, you can't see around the bend, and each step could be your last. Hazards and obstacles block the path, and bloodthirsty monsters await to slaughter your team. 
Will your crew be the first to conquer the unforgiving territory, or will you join all the others who failed? Roll the dice and find out.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2430 - 6x30 Tables

Description:
The Seekers are a junior scout troop who are tasked with finding the Mushroom before he steals all the crystals in the forest.
The Seekers is a 1 vs. Many hidden movement game where 1 player plays as the Mushroom, trying to locate the crystals hiding in the forest, while the others play as the Seekers, using deduction to learn where the Mushroom is. It's like the ultimate game of hide and seek!
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2434 - 6x30 Tables

Description: You're a raccoon. You collect Trash and desired shinies, and you are Sexy! You're on a mission, and you have trouble to get into. Navigate through a series of environments from the mean streets to the deep woods - searching for a prized item almost lost to raccoon memory. Come play the rowdy raccoon story game! Grab one of the five pre-generated Racconicatures and jump right in for mischief and mayhem.
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Knox Room

Description: Great wheels from a forgotten time thunder and clank in the jungle! The verdant jungle has almost consumed the white marble pillars and walls of this ancient temple. Mighty wheels still turn heavily inside its grounds, shaking the earth with each rotation. What forgotten dooms, and portents do these wheels predict? 2nd Level - Cursed Scroll 4
Room: Hyatt - 1st Floor - Hayes Room- Lurking Fears

Description:
Legends speak of a time before the Dark One reigned, bringing their Eclipse of eternal night and despair. Fortunately, the Empire prevailed against their strength, dispelling the darkness with the light. Your settlement in Cleaveslind is the last known stronghold of the Empire and managed to repel the Dark One using ancient Beacons that keep the darkness at bay.

Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Franklin A Room- Matinee Adventures

Description: demo for Aetherstream: Leviathan, FASA Games new capital ship tabletop game. fly a capital ship in a Sci-fi setting and destroy your opponents. no prior experience needed.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2330 - Minis Tables

Event Name: Endangered Orphans: House of Rath (meet the designer!)
Description: Learn this unique Halloween party game with the designer, Joe Boyden!  Run & hide from the bogeyman using rotating room tiles, secret passageways, and locked doors.  Deduce your opponents, then shove them in the way!  Quick game play — 1) Roll a unique action just for you, 2) then move the bogeyman to pick off the others.  Last one standing wins in this macabre, laugh-out-loud game!  Click the link for preview video, rules, and order page.
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2518 - ProtoCLE

Event Name: Trailer Park Warlords of the Apocalypse
Description: Beer Run: Some scrappy gang stumbled across a glorious stash of beer—liquid gold! But then, boom: ambush. Now the streets are glittering with cans like a frat party exploded in a war zone. It’s yours for the taking… if you can dodge bullets, rival gangs, and your own thirst-induced bad decisions.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2330 - Minis Tables

Description: Nile News Flash!  The Scarab of Isis has been stolen from the Cairo Museum of Antiquities.  Can you recover it before something even more nefarious happens?
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Clark Room- The Guild of San Marcos

Description: Being in debt to the Raccuzza is bad, being on Big Daddy's bad side is worse. Players are a group of Street Racing Raccoons who must use all their skills to fight it out in the Raccuzza's Demolition Debry Deathrace for survival and freedom. Cartoon hi-jinks, ridiculous shenanigans, and massive explosions will ensue!
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Morrow Room- Untold Stories Project

Description:
We Are at War! Seemingly everywhere, Perdition teems with demonic WitchBorn risen from the dead. You number among the few bands of roaming survivors—maybe all that is left of your kind!

An airship crashes, jettisoning valuable cargo. Lead your war clan of Dwarves, Elves, Guild, Orcs, Paladins, or others to recover the treasure; but beware, the airship pilot is WitchBorn now!

Rules will be taught and everything is supplied. Your goal is simple. Just survive!
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2334 - Minis Tables

Description: Prove you are the greatest hedgehog knight. Prepare by collecting resources, then bid them in the melee, joust, archery, and dance competitions.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2518 - ProtoCLE

Description: Auction off cards (positive, negative, multiplier, etc.) to try and get the high score. Careful - the person that spends the most loses!
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2300 - Allplay Games

Event Name: Rangers of Shadow Deep - The Shadow Keep
Description: With the fall of the neighboring kingdom to the Shadow Deep, it's time for the king's best to prove their might. It will take the combined efforts of two ranger teams to take down the Shadow Keep. Your ranger and their companions must brave the dangers of the monsters of shadow deep. Rules will be taught, and characters will be provided; no prior experience needed.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2526 - 8x30

Description: Romance, befriend, and SLAY a dungeon full of monsters! Build a stylish adventuring outfit, then use your style to match the interests of fantasy monsters. Features set collection, tableau-building, and loads of cute, silly monster cards. Simultaneous action selection keeps the game moving quickly and your opponents guessing!
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2430 - 6x30 Tables

Description: You are children who possess unique abilities at a facility for gifted youngsters. During an intense thunderstorm, the building loses power. In the red glow of the emergency lights, the forbidden sublevel known as The Never Floor unlocks, and the lies of the facility begin to unravel.
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Champaign Room

Description: Learn to play the Cosmere® RPG! In the 3rd-level Stormlight adventure "Speak the Words," the city of Karanak is under siege by Odium's forces. Your choices could set you on the path to Radiance! No prep is required, but familiarity with d20-based RPGs is recommended. Just bring some dice and a pencil; we'll provide pre-generated characters.
Room: Hyatt - 1st Floor - Hayes Room- Lurking Fears

Description: Hametsu is a cooperative, miniatures tabletop game set in post-apocalyptic 16th Century Japan where mythical Oni demons have emerged after a catastrophic event known as The Cataclysm. Players work together to confront these creatures and must ultimately find and defeat the hidden Boss monster.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2308 - HMGS - GL

Description: INVITATION ONLY from winning in a qualifier
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2212 - Brown Castle Games

Description: Explore all 63 US national parks in this causal set collecting card game that balances building your own sets of national parks while strategically delaying others. The deisgner Jason Wong spent 3 years traveling to all 63 US national parks and created a mahjong-inspired card game that features all his own photography.
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Exhibit Hall Booth - #2505 - Pocket Parks

Description: The Looneys of Looney Labs (makers of Fluxx etc) have countless stories to share about their 30 years in the game industry (and their careers at NASA before that). What’s coming next from the company? Here’s your chance to ask Andy or Kristin anything you want!
Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting A 114 - Looney Labs

Description: Sit down with one of GM's and learn how to or get help with building a Missions legal character to use in our living campaign.
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Union A-B Rooms - Catalyst Game Labs

Balance school and social life as you work together to unmask a hidden villain threatening the city! Combines worker placement, card-based crimefighting, and a light storytelling mechanism for social outings. Nominated for the IndieCade 2025 Award for Tabletop Design.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2530 - Rounds
Game Master (GM): Michael Addison, Nathan Woll, Thor Hansen

Age Range: Kids Only (12 and under. Must be with an adult)
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Union D - The Motley Kids Family Room

Description:
A simple dungeon crawl using modern rules but played in an old school style. Low level fun with a DM who has played the game for 50 years. 
We will use home made dungeon tiles and wooden counters for people and monsters.
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Knox Room

Event Name: Marvel Zombies: A Zombicide Game - Play Zombies
Description: When the zombie plague strikes, not even Earth’s mightiest heroes are safe. Play a Marvel Zombie and try to devour the non-infected
Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting Room B #131 - Rogue Judges

Description: Winner gets a copy of the game! - The excavation of an ancient Incan temple in Peru is about to collapse.  They have hired an expedition team to venture into the ruins, recovering artifacts before they are lost forever.  Players will push their luck, avoiding hazards and recovering gems and artifacts.  Secure the most treasure, and win the game!
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2101 - Eagle-Gryphon Games

Description:
Your lord is dead. Slain not in battle, but betrayed in silence. Poisoned at a banquet by the Daimyō who once called him brother.
Now his killers sit behind lacquered walls, protected by hired blades and political silence. No court will hear your case. No allies will march at your side. The world has already moved on.

But you have your blades. You have each other. And as Ronin, you have nothing left to lose.
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Champaign Room

Description: Journey to a fantasy world of imagination with unicorns, dragons, and mermaids! Local author and magician Erica Carlson performs a family-friendly, interactive magic show that keeps young children and the young at heart engaged with tricks, helpers from the audience, and Sedgie the Hedgie, the live hedgehog!
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - 2nd Floor - Above Reg - Short North Ballroom Stage

Description: Winner gets a copy of the game! - Step into the vibrant trade world of Samarkand Bazaar!  Acquire the most valuable wares in the Bazaar, visit Nomad Camps exchanging and selling goods to acquire wealth, and visit the market where goods are auctioned off.  Samarkand Bazaar is 3 games in one.  Players will choose which they play.
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2101 - Eagle-Gryphon Games

Event Name: Learn to Play Luminous Card Game
Description: Learn how to play Luminous, a 1v1 expandable card game where factions vie for control of a mysterious continent. Players will use pre-constructed decks from our starter set, The Wanderers. After completing their match, players will receive a limited, alternate frame promo of "Quinn, Crown Prince" as a reward.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2426 - 8x30

Description: Uh Oh, Dino! is a cooperative game of bite-size strategy and cute chaos, where every turn you'll face a drawbag of dangers: Earthquakes, Lava, and a shifting board that is literally falling apart under your feet! Stomp, Jump, and Eat your way through the valley, as you cleverly collaborate to rescue all your precious dino eggs-- and each other-- before the whole valley collapses! With adorable dinos, a shifting board, and a drawbag of danger, Uh Oh, Dino! is a cooperative game for adults and kids alike!
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2430 - 6x30 Tables

Description: Planet of the Apes: the Underdwellers have caused psychic manifestations in Ape City. Your team needs to stop them from disrupting Ape-vilization.
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Marion Room

Description: A fast paced, easy to learn game about 14th Century Europe and the outbreak of the Plague - He who dies last wins! Based on our 1993 cult classic, Plague & Pestilence, Of Popes and Plagues is a game for 2-6 players... 5 minutes to learn... 20-30 minutes to play. Each player grows their village while waging war on their enemies and leading Holy Crusades while preparing for the outbreak of the Black Death. Drop in and learn to play - He who dies last wins!
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2430 - 6x30 Tables

Description: You're doing the tough job of redistributing wealth on earth in early modern period (c. 1700). PICARO! puts you in the saddle of a picaresque-inspired adventure as a band of rogues and scallywags lightening the purses of the wealthy. Pull fantastical capers in a magickally-historic version of our world. Learn the rules-light, player-empowering Grit System as you play! Increase your infamy to become the people's hero!
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Union C Room

Description: You deserve a better dungeon crawler! This competitive deck-builder features easy rules, strategic decisions, and short waits between turns. Players will equip their characters, loot the dungeon, and slay monsters in a race to kill the dungeon boss.
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2518 - ProtoCLE

Description: A king of the hill, battle royale style game that is full of strategy, lucky dice rolls, and best of all, you're as big as the game itself! Roll dice to collect victory points, healing hearts, purchasing power. and claws to attack your enemies. The first player to either earn 20 victory points or knock out all other players will be the winner and must shout aloud - "I'M THE KING OF TOKYO!!!"
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting D 180-D 183 Pride Gamers

Description: You are the ruler of a growing kingdom. Your prophets have warned that famine will sweep the entire land over the next few years. To save your people, you’ll need to hire the right workers, balance your resources, and even call upon the magic of mighty wizards! Can you finish the third year with more grain than competing rulers and secure prosperity for your kingdom?
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2104 - Mid Level Meeple

Description: The runners are surprise guest stars in the live-fire finale of the Desert Wars. Will they emerge as viral sensations or be sacrificed in the name of ratings?
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Union A-B Rooms - Catalyst Game Labs

Description: Delve into the dark depths of the Salem Witch Trials. Renowned for its authenticity and recognized with the Dice Tower Seal of Excellence, this game immerses you in a tumultuous era of accusations and terror.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2430 - 6x30 Tables

Description: Discover and collect various types of flower dragons while trying to earn prestige by planting and claiming beautiful gardens of flowers for the next migration of dragons.
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Exhibit Hall Booth - #2219 - B.A. Games

Description: Sometimes your Johnson is a guy in a suit, sometimes it's a dark spirit in a back alley that needs your help to stay alive.
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Union A-B Rooms - Catalyst Game Labs

Description: Learn to play Games Workshop's flagship game in the grim dark universe of Warhammer 40,000
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2412 - SGG

Event Name: Saloon Shootout: A Gunfights & Gamblin' Game
Description: You're a no-good varmint and a card cheat, so you've brought your own cards to the Saloon. The bad news for you is that everyone else at the table is a cheat, too! You'll have to take some risks and play your cards smart once tempers flare and bullets start to fly!
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2104 - Mid Level Meeple

Description: Open 2 Jumpstart packs to build a deck and play a quick match! The winner will earn 1 additional Jumpstart pack.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2500 - Pro-Play Games

Description: This is for folks who want to play a game with other experienced players. Players who sign up for this event should be very comfortable with the following: valid yaku (we have reference sheets), game flow, calls (Chii, Pon, Kan, Ron). You do NOT have to be fluent in scoring manually (we can help with that), and we are happy to teach players how to handle the tiles (if you have only played on an online client). Players should be ready to take less than 5 seconds for most turns to ensure that a full game can fit into the time slot we’ve reserved.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2534 - Rounds

Event Name: Japanese Riichi Mahjong - Learn to Play
Description: If you have seen Japanese style Riichi Mahjong in an anime, manga, TV show, or one of many video games and want to learn how to play yourself, you’re in the right place! We’re prepared to walk you through your first game with a single-page reference sheet to take you from knowing nothing to being able to play a game with minimal help. Mahjong is a tile game focused on set collection with many variants. It is similar in many ways to card games like Gin Rummy where players race to complete valid hands containing sequences and triplets.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2530 - Rounds

Description: A purported Anglo-Saxon manuscript, filled with late Anglo-Saxon art reminiscent of tapestries such as the Bayeaux Tapestry has been offered for sale.  Charles Auerbach wants his Purple Gang enforcers to investigate.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2534 - Rounds
Hosting Company, Group, or Club: Big Bill's Real Murican Commie Crushers

Description: A quick, fun card game of discovering lost goats and treasures as you search an unstable cave. Be careful though. Get too greedy and you may lose it all!
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Exhibit Hall Booth - #2219 - B.A. Games

Description: Set sail in a historical fiction adventure as a daring pirate captain, braving brutal seas, scarcity, and constant danger to carve out your legend. Choose how you plunder, upgrade your ship and crew, and adapt as a living world reacts to your rise through powerful Story Cards. Fortune favors the bold—but only the skilled will be remembered.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2434 - 6x30 Tables

Event Name: River Valley Glassworks - Learn to Play
Description: The beautiful pieces of glass that can be found along the river have attracted the most entrepreneurial of woodland creatures. Store the glass you pick up strategically in your shop. Depending on how the glass pieces are placed, your score will change drastically.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2300 - Allplay Games

Description: The Paranormal/Occult Research Center (PORC) has asked your team to investigate the death of a famous medium. During that investigation, you have become trapped by, what seems to be, the same malevolent spirit that killed the medium. Can you banish the spirit to the netherworld and escape before you become its next victims?
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - 2nd Floor - Meeting Room B #242 - Chicago ConLARP

Description:
You and your friends meet up at a bar during happy hour, but the bar keeps getting busier and busier! Can you navigate your friends through the shuffling crowd to have the most fun of all?!

Hey, Bartender is a competitive, easy to learn board game with a unique NPC movement component. LEARN TO PLAY.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2434 - 6x30 Tables

Description: The Wizard's pet raccoon Sylvester has released all of the wizard's magical beasts from their cages, but luckily, a magic spell was triggered and the creatures have been frozen for a very short time. Can you figure out how to get them back into their cages before the spell wears off and the beasts are released into the realm?
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - 2nd Floor - Meeting Room B #243 - Chicago ConLARP
