Age Range: Kids Only (12 and under. Must be with an adult)
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Union D - The Motley Kids Family Room

Event Name: Escape Room: War within the Thieves Guild!!
Description: The mysterious Scrolls of Membership keep the roster of the guild for the Guildmaster of the Night. Each member's truename ties their life to the Scrolls and removing a name from the Scrolls kills the guild member. Can you recover the Scrolls before your enemies?
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - 2nd Floor - Meeting Room B #244 - Chicago ConLARP

Description: A gut-punch of a game that pits two to six players in an epic team battle over a pioneer town. The question is: are you feeling like a pioneer, or a renegade? Do you want to build the town, or burn it down? It is a game drenched in theme--from keeping track of the game rounds by loading bullets into a revolver chamber, to the tongue-in-cheek descriptions on the cards. Strategy and luck take equal roles as you out-shoot, out-gamble and outsmart the other team to victory!
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2104 - Mid Level Meeple

Event Name: Blood on the Clocktower: Trouble Brewing
Description: [Beginner] A captivating social deduction game of murder, mystery, and demons. Each player has an ability and is never eliminated, and no two games are ever the same. Storytellers will provide a game geared towards new and experienced players. New players are welcome, rules taught.
Room: GCCC - 2nd Floor - Above Reg - Short North Ballroom B

Description: Can you escape this cursed tower? Originally designed to dispose of dangerous and forbidden magics, the tower's mechanisms long ago went awry. It breaks ambient magic down into unstable arcane fragments, incomplete rituals, and scraps of weave. All spellbooks and grimoires are gone, but the echos of their magics are not. All amenities seem to be functional....aside from an escape route. A 5e (2014) adventure for level 3 heroes. Pregen heroes available.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: Hyatt - 1st Floor - Ohio Center A -

Description: It's 1977. You're an up-and-coming musician, dreaming of making it big. Can you earn the most fame and become the best new artist of the year?
Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting Room B #131 - Rogue Judges

Description: Improve your skill tracks to build the best Kokeshi.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2408 - Grand Gamers Guild

Description:
A lively eight person team challenge with built-in twists!
Teams of eight tackle two NEW unpublished 1000pc puzzles in a dynamic relay format that keeps everyone on their toes. Rotate, swap, and adapt as calls of 1-2-3-Go Team Go keep the action moving. Expect strategy, coordination.. and maybe some of your "f"avourite things. ;)

Please see long description for more details & the team form.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall B - #1942 - Tournament of Pieces

Description: Return to Night City in the official co-op, story-driven Cyberpunk card game where your crew and choices shape every run. Be among the first to play before it hits stores.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2200 - Night Crew Games

Description: Easy to learn and quick to play, this game is a chilling introduction to the Ticket to Ride series. In this horrifying edition of the classic Ticket to Ride First Journey, parents and kids collect Parade Float cards, claim routes on the map, and try to visit different locations in this hair-raising town “Knock, knock… Trick or treat!”
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2322 - Rising Phoenix Gaming Club

Description: Pirates, flying ships, a 3-D playing area, and steampunk. What is not to like. Quick easy rules.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2412 - SGG

Description: Set in a once lost magical world. Giant elemental monsters roam while dragons, wizards and warriors battle for dominance over 8 elemental powers. Players control unique factions seeking to adventure, battle, grow in power and ultimately dwell Eldervale, shaping it to their vision.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2422 - Game Base 7

Description: Learn-to-Play or see us again to practice for the Tournaments. Fri/Sat/Sun Tournament winners take home a 2026 Tourney Exclusive Playmat 1/50
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2530 - Rounds

Description: Let's just get together and play Dominion!  Some experience preferred.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2434 - 6x30 Tables

Description:
In this comedy-horror card game, 2-6 players take on the role of one of St. Nick's folkloric companions competing to capture the most Naughty Children. When the boss isn't looking, everything is fair game. Mess with your opponents, sacrifice the worst children, or snitch to Santa to draw his attention elsewhere. Players use their character's unique abilities, upgrades, and action cards to capture the worst children in town. The naughtier the kid, the more valuable they are!

This is a learn-to-play event, so the GM will be teaching all the rules. All players welcome!
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2526 - 8x30

Event Name: Tesla vs Edison: War of Currents
Description:
"Tesla vs. Edison is a fast-playing, route building, economic and worker placement game focused on invention and industry in the roaring 1880's.  Intended for gamers who love of science or history. 
In running your electric company you are both a starry-eyed inventor and a ruthless businessman. You feel pride in bringing electricity to the masses , even as you file patents, engage in a propaganda war, and roll up your sleeves in the stock market. Balancing all sides of an inventor’s enterprise is required to achieve your victory."
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2422 - Game Base 7

Description: Cooperative game about saving the world from an alien invasion.  Each player will command one part of the world defenses and have responsibilities that will come up in the app during the fast-paced timed phase each round.  Then during a non-timed phase, all the decisions made are resolved using dice with press-your-luck mechanics.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2430 - 6x30 Tables

Description: The Witch Kings destroyed everything with their dread magic. Now, we live in a world of Perpetual Eclipse, the last city alive on a sea of sand called the Dread Salt Waste. Without magic and treasure from the ruins and MAZES of the Waste, even the great City of Skull will fall to the Darkness. Delve into the new Mazes expansion "City of Skull" with Maze Architect Patrick Lynn Clapp. Players get a Venturer's Pack! Comes with Zine, dice, player board, and mini!
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: Hyatt - 1st Floor - McKinley Room- 9th Level Games

Description: All you have to do is get the ship's engines (aka "Jump Core") back online and you win, but because there is a hostile alien ship trying to destroy you, that is easier said than done.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2422 - Game Base 7

Description: Do you want to fly around on a starship but don't want to have to do a lot of complicated math? This game has all the fun and flavor of the original. BEGINNERS WELCOME!
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2508 - Broken Leg Gamers

Description: The game of heroic starship adventure puts you at the helm of your own starship. You and your crew will be pilots, engineers, scientists and marines moving around on and operating the starship.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2508 - Broken Leg Gamers

Description: No Man’s Land is a fast-paced, turn-based card game where players battle for control of Big Rock by deploying characters, clashing with rivals, and claiming territory to earn Victory Points before their opponents do.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2518 - ProtoCLE

Description: Inquisutor Dusk has been searching for this artifact for over several weeks to this abandond ancient Hulk of a vessel. I hope we have fewer losses on this run. There are only 6 of us left. OH FETH we have docked. Time to go Emperor be with us. 6 players all characters  All players will receive to take home: dice set,and soft drink of choice
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Marion Room

Description:
You are eligible to inherit a vast fortune, which is hidden in the rooms of an abandoned mansion, and you only have one night to find it. There is one other little problem: the mansion is haunted. Search for hidden money, secret passages, and ridiculous household objects as the cursed clock fills the rooms with monsters, angels, and surprise events. Will you band together to collect the scripture verses that can end the curse, or will you try to collect the most money for yourself?
Learn to play with the game designers!
Room: GCCC - Exhibit Hall Booth - #2206 - Pizza With a Fork

Event Name: Project Cyphon - The Writing on the Walls
Description: Explore the world of Cyberpunk as the hero of your own story, as you help a plucky team of edgerunners dismantle the nefarious Project Cyphon. In this installment, you’ll travel the vendor hall, visiting booths to collect graffiti left by the mysterious Astaire. Collect them all to find a hidden message and unmask the identity of a treacherous ripperdoc!
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting Room B 142 - Roll Your Destiny
Space: Event; Event 11; Event 6; Event 7; Event 12; Event 8; Event 9

Description: Smurfs battling to the death! Pick your army from over 250 figures for a fight to save Smurf village from the evil clutches of Gargamel. Prizes. Simple rules (ages teen to adult).
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2318 - NCG

Event Name: Arrival Push: A Game of Vectors Demo
Description: All-new air traffic control board game with events based on real-life situations, dynamic weather conditions, and a brand new game mechanic. Designed by an actual en-route air traffic controller based in Indianapolis, Arrival Push teaches you how to safely maneuver airplanes across the sky, around obstacles and weather, to the airport.
Room: GCCC - Exhibit Hall Booth - #1020 - Pushing Tin Games

Description:
Learn to play! Game length estimated to be ~2 hrs 

In *Estate: Raise the Realm*, 1–5 players take on the role of noble leaders rebuilding their Estates after the great war, competing to earn the most Victory Points by the fifth Era. Each leader commands unique abilities and an asymmetric tableau, while shifting board actions, Era Events, and Objectives keep every game dynamic. With its blend of worker placement, tableau engine building, and fast-paced play (20 minutes per player), *Estate: Raise the Realm* delivers deep strategy and replayability.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2534 - Rounds

Event Name: ARC Fantasy: Crypt of the Warlock Fiend
Description: Step into a live, interactive fantasy adventure where each player chooses a hero class with unique abilities—cast spells, pick locks, brew potions, speak with animals, and uncover hidden secrets. Work together to explore the mystic woods, complete quests, and ultimately break the Warlock Fiend’s curse. A standalone adventure in the ARC Fantasy series.  (Smartphone required to use class abilities)
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting A #112 - Adventure Room Creations

Event Name: Learn To Play - Age of Steam Deluxe
Description: RULES TAUGHT! - Steam-belching iron horses roar across the land! Relive the era when pioneering railroads built the tracks that transformed the world’s economy.  Players must balance finances, investments, expansions, and locomotive upgrades, all while planning out the best delivery rourtes and paying their creditors.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2101 - Eagle-Gryphon Games

Description: Snacksquatch is a light family concealed bidding game where adventurous kids run outside with makeshift traps to catch all the (imaginary?) monsters in their neighborhood! Bait your traps with your favorite sugary snacks, but be careful – these are monsters! Too much sugar and they’ll get feisty and swat away the higher bidder! Adorable monsters and different scoring rules chalked on the sidewalk every game!
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2518 - ProtoCLE

Description: The card game of Political Dirty Tricks! Run for the White House while engaging in a war of political smears and spin-doctoring!  Learn-to-Play family/party card game. 4 minutes to learn/30-40 minutes to play. Seek out the endorsement of the lil-ole ladies while exposing your opponents and engaging in media spin wars. This is a fast paced game where the outcome will hang on each card played and die rolled. Mechanics include blind bid, take-that and each card having multiple possible uses,
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2426 - 8x30

Description: Learn the basics of chainmail and use them to create your own D20 Pendant. All Materials Provided, no experience necessary.
Room: GCCC - The Union Station A - Silver Host

Event Name: Disney Lorcana Learn to Play Experience
Description:
Starter Deck included with ticket!
As an Illumineer in the wondrous realm of Lorcana, you’ll wield magical ink to summon new versions of Disney characters, items, and locations which are called glimmers. These glimmers—some familiar, some fantastic—will help you as you race across Lorcana to find and collect missing pieces of lore. Endless quests await!
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2500 - Pro-Play Games

Description: Draft your lead singer, musicians, production and backstage staff. Arrange them in the most harmonious ways to unlock more fans, money and opportunities. Plan your schedule, prioritize your assets and select your travel routes as you grow. Chain your rewards into such an amazing show you will leave your competitors behind. But as every superstar knows...watch out for those scandals.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2434 - 6x30 Tables

Event Name: Craft your own Wooden Game Room Sign
Description: Design and craft your own custom wooden sign in this hands-on workshop led by Cube Woodworking. Participants will learn the basics of layout, painting techniques, and finishing while creating a bold, colorful piece inspired by gaming, fandoms, or personal style. No prior experience needed—just bring your creativity! You’ll leave with a unique, handmade sign and the skills to continue crafting at home. All materials are provided.
Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting Room B #143 - Workshop

Description:
A facility-wide emergency protocol has been activated.

Lights flash lavender. Staff freeze in place. A calm voice repeats the same message over and over.

In this psychological horror one-shot, you play patients who remain conscious while the rest of the psychiatric facility is locked in suspended time. As you move through a frozen world, you uncover what Code Lavender is meant to contain and why it failed.

This session focuses on tension, atmosphere, and player-driven choices rather than combat.
Room: Hyatt - Union Rooms Foyer

Description: Mighty Warriors need mighty weapons to take into battle. Come to this class and build your very own boffer sword perfect for fighting in the Amtgard Battlefield.
Room: GCCC - The Union Station A - Silver Host

Description: Players take on the roles of investigators attempting to solve a murder case – but there's a twist. The killer is one of the investigators!
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - 2nd Floor - Above Reg - Short North Ballroom B

Description: Distant worlds collide through time and space to battle on 3D landscapes of Valhalla. Learn to play this classic fantasy miniatures board game using the Age of Annihilation Master Set.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2116 - Heroscape

Description: When a promising student is found dead within the wards of Aetheria Academy, panic stirs in the halls of Witchdom’s most prestigious institution. Players take on the roles of Fates, witches who enforce the Covenants and hunt renegade witches.  You must unravel a web of secrets, rivalries, and dangerous spellwork and bring whoever is responsible to justice before more lives are lost.
Room: Hyatt - Clark Rooms Foyer

Event Name: The Night Crew: The Creeping Cold of Seul Choix Pointe
Description:
A "creeping cold" threatens the Seul Choix Pointe lighthouse. You'll investigate, navigate a history of murder, betrayal, and frozen bodies to find which spirit is the source. Based on a real location and its hauntings, this mystery serves as an intro to The Night Crew, a TTRPG about investigating legends and folklore of Michigan.
This is a rules-light, story-first collaborative experience that is designed to be friendly to new players.

Note: This system is actively in development. By joining this session, you will have the opportunity to be credited as an official beta tester!
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2530 - Rounds

Description: EVE: War for New Eden is a competitive 4X strategy game set in the EVE Online universe. Players lead rival factions, expanding territory, building economies, and commanding fleets in a struggle for galactic dominance. Long-term planning, diplomacy, and well-timed conflict are essential, as every decision shapes the balance of power. Designed for medium-heavy strategy fans, this session includes a full teach and a deliberate pace for new players.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2530 - Rounds

Event Name: Sanctuary: The Game of Cat Rescue
Description: CATS.  They’re adorable, they’re playful, they’re our little fur babies. And now you get to rescue them!  Players take charge of sanctuaries, gathering resources and taking cats out of the city shelter. They then match those adorable pets with adopters who are searching for their unique traits. The rescuers who find the most homes for cats, and who achieve other goals, will win the game. But be careful not to let the city shelter fill up beyond capacity, or everyone loses.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2534 - Rounds

Description: Join creator Luke Stratton and other experienced GMs in a convention-long Pirate Borg Island Crawl. Play for an hour or play all conventions long with multiple tables and GMs. Build your character at the Limithron booth, or use a pregen, then hit the Dead Islands! Want to play multiple times throughout the convention? Your character will be back at the tavern, ready to continue when you return.
Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting B 130 - Limithron & Vast Grimm
Game Master (GM): Zachary Gibbs, Gregory Harris, Ansel Burch

Description: Come try & win a laser etched wood card box in our tournament. The final will be on Sunday at 11:00 AM. The single winner of each of the six qualifying rounds will advance to the final on Sunday at 11:00 AM. The winner gets a laser etched wood Fluxx card box in our tournament. In this game you draw a card and then play a card. The cards played can change the rules and win conditions of the game.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2322 - Rising Phoenix Gaming Club

Description: Fairyland, a twisted nightmare of the tales you once knew. In The House of Lost Dolls, a crumbling mansion holds the key to escape, but porcelain dolls lurk, eager to play… forever. Can you survive their deadly games, or will Fairyland claim you, body and soul? Dark humor, danger, and eerie whimsy.
Room: Hyatt - Clark Rooms Foyer

Description: It’s a clash of fashion titans, and only you can crown the winner. Strut, scheme, and slay the competition, or you’ll be left on the cutting room floor.
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Union A-B Rooms - Catalyst Game Labs

Description:
The Gamilons and the Comet Empire have deployed their most powerful warships for a titanic showdown with the EDF.  Dreadnaughts, battleships, and battlecruisers of four star navies will clash when the order is given to “Engage the enemy battleline!” 
Bigger ships, bigger explosions, bigger fun!
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2318 - NCG

Description: Lead your research institute to explore ocean depths and publish your findings!
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2408 - Grand Gamers Guild

Event Name: Armchair Dragoons: Emperor's Choice & The Emperor's Voice
Description: Pre-publication game covering the internal workings of the Japanese government at the end of WW2.  Will there be a surrender, or a fight to the death?  How will each faction influence the emperor to make a decision?
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2312 - Armchair Dragoons

Description: You are new students at Aerethia Academy and are barely settled in when you hear about the Luna Run, a yearly tradition where first years have one night to run a gauntlet of challenges before the morning bell. Do you dare break curfew to attempt it and earn the respect of the older students?
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Champaign Room

Description: Abandon Hope All Ye Who Enter Here.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2408 - Grand Gamers Guild

Description: Cross swords with red coats and the undead, hack your way through Dark Caribbean jungles, and discover the secrets of ASH in this intro scenario! You'll be playing through Part 1 of our Starter Set. PIRATE BORG is a rules-light, grimdark, scurvy-ridden d20 RPG. We will start with fast character creation. Multiple games are run at once, so walk-ups and waitlists are available at the event location.
Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting B 130 - Limithron & Vast Grimm

Description: N'awlins turns into one Big Uneasy when Renée Martin and Claudette Laurier invite Old Man to the table to join forces and call upon a team of runners.
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Union A-B Rooms - Catalyst Game Labs

Description: Play the Gods of Glorantha (the setting of RuneQuest) as they vie for victory during the Gods Wat at the beginning of time. Factions include Storm, Sky, Sea, Earth, Darkness, Moon, Invisible God and Chaos.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2330 - Minis Tables

Description: Dueling factions slug it out in the wild west. Wild West shootout in 54mm.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2420 - Ottawa Red Shirts

Description: 16 players will compete in a single elimination, 1v1 event, playing 1 game each round, over 4 rounds. All materials provided. Knowledge of rules required. Ages 9+ Participation and winner prizes. Players will each receive 2 characters to play at the start of the event. At the end of each round, the winner will discard their winning character and take all of their opponent’s characters, adding them to their own roster, before choosing 3 characters from that roster to take into the next round. Format details available from the Unmatched Event guides https://linktr.ee/restorationgames
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting A 120 - Restoration Games

Description: Monster Gladiatorial. Slay or be slain.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2420 - Ottawa Red Shirts

Description: Play and Learn with Game Creator! -unique 7d12 system- Roleplay angels fighting evil spirits and guiding humans. Spiritual-Fantasy gameplay of biblical proportions.
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Union C Room

Description: A ship this big is worth fighting over. Awesome piratey shipboard mayhem in 54 mm!
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2420 - Ottawa Red Shirts

Description: Become the most popular conspiracy podcaster by connecting the dots, gaining evidence and proving conspiracies to gain new subscribers. As you move around the board you leave breadcrumbs of evidence for other players to find. Gain followers as other players talk about your conspiracies.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2518 - ProtoCLE

Description: Someone or something has been eating your homework at Aetheria Academy. Spells are vanishing, essays are shredded, and grades are plummeting. Your academic future is on the line unless you can uncover the truth. What you find is a mischievous little paper dragon with a big appetite and no intention of stopping. Can you outwit a creature made of ink, enchantments, and origami before your GPA goes up in smoke?
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Champaign Room

Description: Can you save the world, or will you lose your sanity?  Players are either Investigators trying to keep Cthulhu from waking and controlling the world, or Cultists that want to bring the world to a disturbing end.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - 2nd Floor - Above Reg - Short North Ballroom B

Description: Take turns telling your friends exactly how the bear tries to eat them and then listen to them try to desperately avoid getting eaten. Then let the Jenga tower decide what happens.
Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting D 180-D 183 Pride Gamers

Event Name: Merchants of Andromeda - Learn to Play
Description: Seek riches in a game of space politics - casting votes in the Senate, bidding on lucrative space goods, or resorting to ship combat!
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2300 - Allplay Games

Description: Set in the universe of GW's Warhammer 40K, this game pits the Imperium against the Orks as the orks in a shipyard where their fearsome Submarine is ungoing repairs
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2412 - SGG

Description: Romance, befriend, and SLAY a dungeon full of monsters! Build a stylish adventuring outfit, then use your style to match the interests of fantasy monsters. Features set collection, tableau-building, and loads of cute, silly monster cards. Simultaneous action selection keeps the game moving quickly and your opponents guessing!
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2430 - 6x30 Tables

Description:
Extinction Point is a thrilling cooperative card game that uniquely blends the classic strategy of trick-taking with the desperate creativity of base-building.

You and your fellow leaders must win tricks to take actions - using the very cards you played in the tricks to build structures, recruit people, and create weapons and shields to survive against the Mothership's attacks.

But be warned... You must do all this while outsmarting an Alien Infiltrator sent to sabotage your plans!

Every trick is a tense decision. Every round brings you closer to victory... Or extinction!
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2430 - 6x30 Tables

Event Name: Shackleton Series: Episode 1 - Interactive Puzzle Adventure
Description: The Shackleton Series is a 6-episode tabletop escape game. The storyline follows the true account of how 28 men got trapped off the coast of Antartica for 2 years, and everyone made it home alive. In this session you'll play the first episode in the series hosted by one of the designers of the game, Eric Reynolds or Paul Harvey. Each episode is packed with recreations of beautiful artifacts from the expedition. Players work together as a team to find clues, and solve puzzles as they explore the remarkable story of how Shackleton and his crew managed to escape from Antarctica.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Exhibit Hall Booth - #2409 - Escape Mail

Description: We are back for yet another amazing year! Come build & take home a 3ft safe LARP cloth covered foam sword that can last for years. Generics always welcome. Come anytime to our area that we are open "10 - 5" to build!
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting Room B 144 - Stronghold LARP Foam

Description:
With an inter-planetary mission of utmost importance in hand, you're set to go down in infamy for your efforts. However, your ship begins to disintegrate in the atmosphere, and you're forced to evacuate quickly. After landing on this unknown world, you realize that you're far from your other crew members. You must: investigate your surroundings, decide how to travel the terrain, collect items to boost your performance, and most importantly, achieve your mission as a crew before fate deals another option.

Can your team achieve greatness? Perhaps... even an epic victory?
Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting D 180-D 183 Pride Gamers

Event Name: FluentSea, UPCOMING RELEASE Learn and Play!
Description:
Coming to Kickstarter Fall of 2026, FluentSea is a word-building, reef-restoration game where every word you make brings a bleached coral reef back to life. You build the best word you can each round, and the longer the word, the more marine species you get to place—like octopus, coral, clownfish, and schooling fish. Each species scores differently based on real behaviors, so clever wordplay and smart ecology both matter. Heal the reef, build the ecosystem, and score the most points to win.

Designed by David Gordon, Travis Magrum and Jon Glimour-Long with development by Leonie Grundler.
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: Lioness Games  - Exhibit Hall Booth 2605

Event Name: Project Cyphon - The Flaw in the System
Description: Explore the world of Cyberpunk as the hero of your own story, as you help a plucky team of edgerunners dismantle the nefarious Project Cyphon. In this installment, you’ll explore the convention center to locate terminals installed by Braindance Inc. There, you’ll meet inhabitants of Night City who will help you hack these terminals and take down Project Cyphon’s insidious BDL network for good.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting Room B 142 - Roll Your Destiny

Event Name: Recruiting Crew: Roll a Pirate Borg Character
Description: Become part of the crew! Enter the pirate ship at the Limithron booth, sit at the captain’s table, and create your very own wretched soul with the help of a seasoned harbourmaster. You'll be generating a character, then learning the basic rules. Afterwards, take your pirate and join the convention-long "Plunder the Dead Islands" event or a full adventure! (sign-up separately)
Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting B 130 - Limithron & Vast Grimm

Description: In this game each quest you draft has a unique objective you’ll strive to complete by pairing your rolled dice with mercenaries from unique classes, Each class not only sets the win condition for the trick but also possesses a powerful CRIT ability that could shift the odds of the game in your favor. Rise to the Barkeep’s Challenge in every round, winning the right number of tricks to claim extra loot. Lighten the pockets of your new 'friends' to win the game—but be wary, or you might walk away with more rivals than riches.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2434 - 6x30 Tables

Event Name: The WitchBorn: The Pit, Another Night
Description:
We Are at War! Seemingly everywhere, Perdition teems with demonic WitchBorn risen from the dead. You number among the few roaming survivors—maybe all that is left of your kind!

Take refuge in "The Pit!" This derelict cathedral was converted into Perdition's last tavern. Tip the Oni bouncer and he'll be sure Broken Doll and the help take care of you. Cause trouble and he'll snap your neck. Meet Dark Trader, a Guild Master with access to muscle, magic, and carefully guarded secrets. There are no WitchBorn here, so there's probably no better time for a beer! (Just try to avoid the brawls!)
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2334 - Minis Tables

Event Name: Tokyo S.O.S. Kaiju Attack! Learn to play
Description:
In this pulse-pounding cooperative game, your team must outsmart a rampaging Kaiju hellbent on destroying Japan. Each player chooses from a variety of unique heroes, and uses action cards and military units to stop the unstoppable Kaiju advancement. You must work together to complete missions and save Japan, or the world may turn the entire country into collateral damage. 80's anime vibes collide with the battles of classic Kaiju cinema!

We will be running 2 games at the same time, 5 players per game.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2530 - Rounds

Event Name: Project Cyphon - The Writing on the Walls
Description: Explore the world of Cyberpunk as the hero of your own story, as you help a plucky team of edgerunners dismantle the nefarious Project Cyphon. In this installment, you’ll travel the vendor hall, visiting booths to collect graffiti left by the mysterious Astaire. Collect them all to find a hidden message and unmask the identity of a treacherous ripperdoc!
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting Room B 142 - Roll Your Destiny
Space: Event; Event 11; Event 6; Event 7; Event 12; Event 8; Event 9

Description: Auction off cards (positive, negative, multiplier, etc.) to try and get the high score. Careful - the person that spends the most loses!
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2300 - Allplay Games

Description: Learn-to-Play or see us again to practice for the Tournaments. Fri/Sat/Sun Tournament winners take home a 2026 Tourney Exclusive Playmat 1/50
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2530 - Rounds

Description:
When the Imperium of Man is threatened by particularly dangerous individuals only the Officio Assassinorum can be trusted with their removal. For more than one agent to be sent, the threat must be dire indeed.
Take on the role of an imperial assassin and work together to take down a lord of chaos on their own corrupted world.
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Franklin A Room- Matinee Adventures

Description:
Stake your claim over the islands by building your pirate lair and earning the most renown in this open-world pirate adventure game. Sink the ships of the tyrannical Imperial Navy, plunder merchant vessels, explore ancient island ruins, and encounter legendary perils on the high seas. Don’t forget to choose the right shanty for your crew to sing each day for special boons! 

Renown can be earned by doing just about any pirate-y thing you want to do. Have the most renown by the end of the game to become the Pirate King/Queen!
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2530 - Rounds

Description: Ave Citizens! Welcome to an alternate historical fantasy version of Imperial Rome. Create a character and play through an adventure in Windmill Game Co's newest game system. This will be your chance to not only affect the world but the game itself in this Beta Test of our newest setting and rules system.
Room: Hyatt - 1st Floor - Ohio Center A -

Description:
In this comedy-horror card game, 2-6 players take on the role of one of St. Nick's folkloric companions competing to capture the most Naughty Children. When the boss isn't looking, everything is fair game. Mess with your opponents, sacrifice the worst children, or snitch to Santa to draw his attention elsewhere. Players use their character's unique abilities, upgrades, and action cards to capture the worst children in town. The naughtier the kid, the more valuable they are!

This is a learn-to-play event, so the GM will be teaching all the rules. All players welcome!
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2526 - 8x30

Event Name: Rotted Capes Issue #2 / Navada Enclave: The Broken Tower
Description: “You didn’t save the enclave… You bought it time.” A week after the outbreak, your home is dying. Power is failing. Air is running out. The only fix lies beyond the walls in a dead zone filled with twisted machines and the infected. To save everyone, you’ll have to bring back a critical power core… and survive another encounter with the thing that nearly tore the tower apart. Heroes Provided.
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Delaware A-D Rooms- The Gathering

Event Name: Betrayal at House on the Hill
Description:
"Betrayal at House on the Hill quickly builds suspense and excitement as players explore a haunted mansion of their own 'design', encountering spirits and frightening omens that foretell their fate. 
Secretly, one of the characters betrays the rest of the party, and the innocent members of the party must defeat the traitor in their midst before it’s too late! Betrayal at House on the Hill will appeal to any game player who enjoys a fun, suspenseful, and strategic game."
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2422 - Game Base 7

Description: An automated factory has gone crazy and is cranking out killbots. Your mission objective is to stop them before they overrun the galaxy. Come play with the huge scale models. Beginners are welcome.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2508 - Broken Leg Gamers

Description: Your party is enjoying a rare quiet evening at The Prancing Pony when a hunter shares a story about discovering a hill in the North Downs with ancient standing stones and a terrifying vision he had while there. The next morning, the Company sets out from Bree, heading north. After days of travel in the wild, they reach the Crowned Hill.
Room: Hyatt - 1st Floor - Hayes Room- Lurking Fears

Description: It is the week before Alphaeus Jona’s arranged wedding to Talia val’Borda of Plexus. Friends, foes, political allies and adversaries alike have descended on the capital city of Metra to gain favor or spread fervor during the festivities. Adventure optimized for 4th-level characters, pre-gens available.
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Delaware A-D Rooms- The Gathering

Description: Worlds Collide! A semi-cooperative boardgame that makes players heroes from one of two fantastic worlds that have collided! Samurai Dinosaurs? Kaiju Western? Superspy Camelot?
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2508 - Broken Leg Gamers

Event Name: Everyday Heroes, Learn to Play: Gettin Paid with Dirty Money
Description: New Players welcome! Rules taught, pregen heroes available. No experience needed. Your benevolent fixer, Chuckie, has set up the perfect gig for you: taking back dirty money from organized crime in Arch City! The Casa Nostra Antiquities shop holds a TON of ill-gotten gains in its back room, and now is the time to deal a blow to the criminals’ horde and…get paid!
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: Hyatt - 1st Floor - Grant Room- Evil Genius Games

Event Name: LNTE03: A Tear in the Velvet Lantern
Description:
LNTE03: A Tear in the Velvet Lantern
A night of celebration at the Velvet Lantern turns grim when a guest is found dead under mysterious circumstances. The city needs sharp minds to uncover what happened so justice can be served. Can you unravel the truth hidden behind smiles, secrets, and shadows? An adventure for 1st through 4th level players, based on the Bestselling "Chaos Seeds" books by Dr. Aleron Kong. New Players Welcome, we will teach rules at the table. All materials provided.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)

Description: The Miskatonic Tales: Journey to Innsmouth Board Game contains three stand-alone adventures that can be played separately, yet share one large story arc. Each time you play, the story can be different. What role will you play? Investigate the clues and uncover the truth.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2112 - Chaosium

Description: A cross between HeroQuest and Breath of the Wild, in this tactical dungeon crawl players take on the role of heroes and delve into a labyrinth to find treasure to craft into weapons, armor, and magic items.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2534 - Rounds

Description: High school, the coming of age deathtrap. Play as the jock, weirdo, popular kid, and everything in between - all marked as present and trying to survive (and maybe do their homework?) Saturday Detention in the High School in the Suburbs surrounding the City at the Center of the Anime Multiverse.
Room: Hyatt - 1st Floor - Ohio Center A -

Event Name: Arrival Push: A Game of Vectors Demo
Description: All-new air traffic control board game with events based on real-life situations, dynamic weather conditions, and a brand new game mechanic. Description: Ten Candles is described as a "tragic horror" game rather than survival horror for one main reason: in Ten Candles there are no survivors. Instead, it is a game about what happens in the dark, and about those who try to survive within it. It is a game about being pushed to the brink of madness and despair, searching for hope in a hopeless world, and trying to do something meaningful with your final few hours left.

Event Name: Fail Hard: How Tabletop Games Teach Resilience Through Play
Description:
Jesse "Doc" Edmond - Katie Lear, LCMHC, RPT, RDT - Jaclyn Lewis - Olivia "Liv" Larbi
Failure is baked into tabletop RPGs: missed rolls, flawed plans, and unexpected consequences. In a psychologically safe play space, setbacks become opportunities to practice frustration tolerance, emotional regulation, and growth mindset. Drawing on youth facilitation and clinical experience, this panel explores how table culture, narrative framing, and collaborative storytelling naturally build confidence, social awareness, and perseverance—by protecting play rather than formal intervention.

Room: GCCC - 2nd Floor - Above Reg - Short North Ballroom B

Description: Far-future factions compete for control over the galaxy in this light trick-taking negotiation game for 4-6 players. Players form alliances every round, each centered on achieving a specific condition to earn influence. Your hand of cards is partially visible to the whole table, so with whom do you ally to give yourself the best chance of success (and do they see it the same way)? Any players who cross the victory threshold in the same round win together. This is a prototype game which will be taught by the creator under the banner of ProtoCLE, Cleveland’s board game design community.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2518 - ProtoCLE

Event Name: Smores Galore + Smores Galore Roll & Write
Description: Combine marshmallows, chocolate, and graham crackers to concoct and score sweet treats!
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2408 - Grand Gamers Guild

Event Name: Recruiting Crew: Roll a Pirate Borg Character
Description: Become part of the crew! Enter the pirate ship at the Limithron booth, sit at the captain’s table, and create your very own wretched soul with the help of a seasoned harbourmaster. You'll be generating a character, then learning the basic rules. Afterwards, take your pirate and join the convention-long "Plunder the Dead Islands" event or a full adventure! (sign-up separately)
Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting B 130 - Limithron & Vast Grimm

Description: Auction off cards (positive, negative, multiplier, etc.) to try and get the high score. Careful - the person that spends the most loses!
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2300 - Allplay Games

Description: Come test your skills at Dominion in a fun and challenging environment!  Some experience preferred, prizes will be given. Length of event will depend on player count.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2434 - 6x30 Tables

Description: Learn-to-Play or see us again to practice for the Tournaments. Fri/Sat/Sun Tournament winners take home a 2026 Tourney Exclusive Playmat 1/50
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2530 - Rounds

Description: Try out the Infinity Constructed format in which ALL cards are legal! Bring your own deck. Up to 3 Swiss Rounds, Best-of-3. Each player will earn 1 pack per match won.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2500 - Pro-Play Games

Description: This gorgeous deckbuilding/bidding game gives a fresh twist to deckbuilding. Spend the resource cards from your hand to win special power cards and build your towers.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2508 - Broken Leg Gamers

Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2508 - Broken Leg Gamers

Description:
In this comedy-horror card game, 2-6 players take on the role of one of St. Nick's folkloric companions competing to capture the most Naughty Children. When the boss isn't looking, everything is fair game. Mess with your opponents, sacrifice the worst children, or snitch to Santa to draw his attention elsewhere. Players use their character's unique abilities, upgrades, and action cards to capture the worst children in town. The naughtier the kid, the more valuable they are!

This is a learn-to-play event, so the GM will be teaching all the rules. All players welcome!
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2526 - 8x30

Description: Build 3D structures by strategically placing cubes within a limited grid. Score more points by being the first to complete 3D shapes and pattern-based objectives! 2-4 players.
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2518 - ProtoCLE

Description: Smurf to the death! Pick your two Smurf team and battle it out in this one-hour version of the Smurf Wars game. Prizes. Simple rules (ages tween to adult).
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2318 - NCG

Event Name: Project Cyphon - The Writing on the Walls
Description: Explore the world of Cyberpunk as the hero of your own story, as you help a plucky team of edgerunners dismantle the nefarious Project Cyphon. In this installment, you’ll travel the vendor hall, visiting booths to collect graffiti left by the mysterious Astaire. Collect them all to find a hidden message and unmask the identity of a treacherous ripperdoc!
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting Room B 142 - Roll Your Destiny

Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2222 - TGA

Description: Join the 1 MILLION others who learned to make EASY and BEAUTIFUL fantasy world maps. Stress free, beginner friendly environment - no mistakes, just happy accidents! Supplies provided and participants will take home the watercolor map they've made in the workshop.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting Room A #123 - Workshop

Event Name: PAINT & PLAY D&D: Mystery in the Moonshae Isles
Description: Choose a pre-made character with matching miniature, personalize it through painting, then jump into a one-shot adventure!
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: Hyatt - 1st Floor - Ohio Center A -

Description: The card game of Political Dirty Tricks! Run for the White House while engaging in a war of political smears and spin-doctoring!  Learn-to-Play family/party card game. 4 minutes to learn/30-40 minutes to play. Seek out the endorsement of the lil-ole ladies while exposing your opponents and engaging in media spin wars. This is a fast paced game where the outcome will hang on each card played and die rolled. Mechanics include blind bid, take-that and each card having multiple possible uses,
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2434 - 6x30 Tables

Event Name: Blood on the Clocktower: Pies Baking
Description: [Experienced] A different take on TB, Pies Baking replaces Investigator with Noble as well as Undertaker with Cannibal; each playing in a similar fashion. Marionette joins the minions to add another layer of “What level of drunkenness do I have?”
Room: GCCC - 2nd Floor - Above Reg - Short North Ballroom B

Event Name: ARC Fantasy: Crypt of the Warlock Fiend
Description: Step into a live, interactive fantasy adventure where each player chooses a hero class with unique abilities—cast spells, pick locks, brew potions, speak with animals, and uncover hidden secrets. Work together to explore the mystic woods, complete quests, and ultimately break the Warlock Fiend’s curse. A standalone adventure in the ARC Fantasy series.  (Smartphone required to use class abilities)
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting A #112 - Adventure Room Creations

Description: RULES TAUGHT! - In 2032 baseball had to revolutionize the game!  Games were shortened, pitchers got bionic arm implants, robotic players were added to keep up at the plate, and fielding 'bots are rumored to be next.  Human players (Naturals) are still a big part of the game, being the best fielders and most beloved by the fans.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2101 - Eagle-Gryphon Games

Description: This class will teach how to transfer an image onto leather and use the appropriate tools to bring that image into a basic 3 dimensional design on leather.
Room: GCCC - The Union Station A - Silver Host

Description: Join creator Luke Stratton and other experienced GMs in a convention-long Pirate Borg Island Crawl. Play for an hour or play all conventions long with multiple tables and GMs. Build your character at the Limithron booth, or use a pregen, then hit the Dead Islands! Want to play multiple times throughout the convention? Your character will be back at the tavern, ready to continue when you return.
Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting B 130 - Limithron & Vast Grimm
Game Master (GM): Sharon Bee Cheng, Zachary Gibbs, Hank Wong

Description:
A hunting party from the town of Stennard has gone missing, help is needed to search the Western Woods and bring back the missing townsfolk.  Will you heed the call??
This is a funnel adventure for 0 level peasants
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: Hyatt - 1st Floor - Ohio Center A -

Description: A stand-alone 2-player game based on the hit deduction game, Corps of Discovery. In this game, you and your partner are placing tiles to create a map by following logic rules!
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2430 - 6x30 Tables

Event Name: Grendel: The Game of Crime and Mayhem
Description: Battle over control of New York in this asymmetric brawler. Uses a never-before-seen component/mechanic that increases tension until a tower 'drops' which triggers a massacre!
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2430 - 6x30 Tables

Event Name: Merchants of Andromeda - Learn to Play
Description: Seek riches in a game of space politics - casting votes in the Senate, bidding on lucrative space goods, or resorting to ship combat!
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2300 - Allplay Games

The fast paced flicking game plays 2-4 players who are flicking their discs (player pieces) to outscore their opponents. Come sit for 5 minutes & enjoy a round or several ?you?ll be hooked with the Best Flickin? Game!
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2212 - Brown Castle Games

Description: Become the most popular conspiracy podcaster by connecting the dots, gaining evidence and proving conspiracies to gain new subscribers. As you move around the board you leave breadcrumbs of evidence for other players to find. Gain followers as other players talk about your conspiracies.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2518 - ProtoCLE

Event Name: Junkernauts: A Robot-Building Game of Tactical Combat
Description: Junkernauts is a strategy game for two players where you control rival tribes of smart appliances trying to take over the world. Gain victory by capturing the flag, scoring in Junkerball, and destroying enemy bots to harvest their remains!
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2526 - 8x30

Description: Learn to play the Cosmere® RPG! In the 3rd-level Stormlight adventure "Speak the Words," the city of Karanak is under siege by Odium's forces. Your choices could set you on the path to Radiance! No prep is required, but familiarity with d20-based RPGs is recommended. Just bring some dice and a pencil; we'll provide pre-generated characters.
Room: Hyatt - 1st Floor - Hayes Room- Lurking Fears

Description: Winner gets a copy of the game! - We invite you to dive into this fast-paced push-your-luck dice game, where players race to reach the finish line by tactically rolling dice. The balance of strategy and chance are sure to evoke laughter, tension and memorable moments.  Can you stop?
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2101 - Eagle-Gryphon Games

Event Name: Artemis Spaceship Bridge Simulator - Cosmos Edition!
Description: Join five of your friends or complete strangers as you take control of a spaceship bridge. Whether you voyage with old friends or soon to be new friends, this will be one of the most enjoyable team-building experiences that you have ever had. This popular annual event will be using the latest version of Artemis Cosmos.
Room: GCCC - 2nd Floor - Meeting Room B #245 - GamingNomads

Description: Pirates, flying ships, a 3-D playing area, and steampunk. What is not to like. Quick easy rules.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2412 - SGG

Description: Build factories, produce containers, set prices, negotiate with your rivals, and sail across the sea to trade. Obviously, buy low, sell high. But, can you make it happen?
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2300 - Allplay Games

Room: GCCC - Exhibit Hall Booth - #2504 - Indie Games Collective

Event Name: Blood on the Clocktower: Trouble Brewing
Description: [Beginner] A captivating social deduction game of murder, mystery, and demons. Each player has an ability and is never eliminated, and no two games are ever the same. Storytellers will provide a game geared towards new and experienced players. New players are welcome, rules taught.
Room: GCCC - 2nd Floor - Above Reg - Short North Ballroom B

Description: Magical Athlete is a racing game of pure chaos! Roll a die and move your racer that many spaces — but all the racers have wacky, game-breaking abilities. Race four times, then whoever has the most points wins!
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2434 - 6x30 Tables

Description: Super heavies and Lords of War battle it out for control of the battlefield. Rarely do you see 28mm scale titans (over a foot tall) on the battlefield.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2412 - SGG

Description: The Paranormal/Occult Research Center (PORC) has asked your team to investigate the death of a famous medium. During that investigation, you have become trapped by, what seems to be, the same malevolent spirit that killed the medium. Can you banish the spirit to the netherworld and escape before you become its next victims?
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - 2nd Floor - Meeting Room B #242 - Chicago ConLARP

Description: The Wizard's pet raccoon Sylvester has released all of the wizard's magical beasts from their cages, but luckily, a magic spell was triggered and the creatures have been frozen for a very short time. Can you figure out how to get them back into their cages before the spell wears off and the beasts are released into the realm?
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - 2nd Floor - Meeting Room B #244 - Chicago ConLARP

Description: Bring your own Premier deck and face off against other players! Up to 3 Swiss Rounds, Best-of-3. Each player will earn 1 pack per match won.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2500 - Pro-Play Games

Event Name: Escape Room: War within the Thieves Guild!!
Description: The mysterious Scrolls of Membership keep the roster of the guild for the Guildmaster of the Night. Each member's truename ties their life to the Scrolls and removing a name from the Scrolls kills the guild member. Can you recover the Scrolls before your enemies?
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - 2nd Floor - Meeting Room B #243 - Chicago ConLARP

Event Name: Kings of War: Champions - Learn to Play
Description: Have you ever wanted to get into a quick miniature game but were intimidated by the large number of miniatures needed and which units to begin with?  Mantics rank & flank game uses fixed Companies each led by a champion. Everything you need for the company is in the box, which plays on your kitchen table. Learn to be a real Champion. Everything provided.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2120 - Ohio War Kings

Event Name: Blood on the Clocktower: Bad Moon Rising
Description: [Intermediate] Jump into a new version of Blood on the Clocktower. After you've tried Trouble Brewing try one of the intermediate scripts included in the base game. Our Storytellers will explain changes and answer questions, however prior knowledge of the rules is required.
Room: GCCC - 2nd Floor - Above Reg - Short North Ballroom B

Description: Your quiet little 16th century village has suddenly become infested with some very unfriendly werewolves...can you and the other villagers find them before they devour everyone? Beginners and Veterans are welcome!
Room: GCCC - The Union Station Foyer -

Event Name: FaeKin: A simple but elegant social deduction game
Description:
Join us to play FaeKin, an elegant social deduction game where everyone can lie... but no one has to.
Born from the forbidden love between the heirs of the Summer and Winter Fae Courts, your parents are gone, leaving the realm in a quandary. To decide your fate, the Fae have devised a game. Crown the player in your court with the highest value identity and dagger the rival player with the highest rank to win! Information is revealed with each duel. Can you trust your own instincts, let alone your fellow Fae?
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: Lioness Games  - Exhibit Hall Booth 2605

Event Name: Survive the Night: Carnage at Camp Ojibwe
Description: A D6 horror RPG for any experience level, pregen characters provided. Snow has come early to Camp Ojibwe, and with it something hungry. Armed only with what you brought to camp, you must cross the cold wilderness and hope to reach the parking lot before each member of your group is hunted down.
Room: Hyatt - Clark Rooms Foyer

Description: Learn to play Games Workshop's flagship game in the grim dark universe of Warhammer 40,000
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2412 - SGG

Description: A quick, fun card game of discovering lost goats and treasures as you search an unstable cave. Be careful though. Get too greedy and you may lose it all!
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Exhibit Hall Booth - #2219 - B.A. Games

Description: Gerrymander berries on a cake in this 2 player strategy game. Berry easy to learn, hard to master. Giant version of the game! Ages 8 - 88. Family & Colorblind Friendly.
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2518 - ProtoCLE

Description:
Monsters are attacking the town, and kid detectives known as the Creeps have to figure out which ones they can trap! Only the monsters with the most cards under them will score, but you also need those same monster cards in your hand to get points, so you have to decide when to play a monster card and when to keep it in your hand.

With The Creeps: The Monster-Trapping Game, you can play the "family game" for quicker games and younger audiences, or play the "full game" for asymmetric powers, game-changing trap cards, and more strategic scoring options.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2430 - 6x30 Tables

Description: Adventure into the woods to forage truffles and other edible plants. You will have to decide to either sale them to the market immediately or ice them for later rounds for potentially greater value.
Room: GCCC - Exhibit Hall Booth - #2219 - B.A. Games

Event Name: Project Cyphon - The Belly of the Beast
Description: Explore the world of Cyberpunk as the hero of your own story, as you help a plucky team of edgerunners dismantle the nefarious Project Cyphon. In this installment, you’ve got 40 minutes to explore a private room inside the premiere night club Second Sight. Your goal? Break into the briefcase of the suit responsible for the Project Cyphon scheme, and secure the prototype for their upcoming tech release before it’s too late!
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting Room B 142 - Roll Your Destiny

Description: Lewis and Clark explore America...and fight monsters! This 1-4 player co-operative deduction and survival game uses a unique contraption unlike anything you've seen!
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2430 - 6x30 Tables

Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - 2nd Floor - Above Reg - Short North Ballroom B

Description:
Join us to play on the largest, most immersive 3D version of the Nemesis in existence. 
Survive an alien-infested spaceship, but beware of other players and their agendas!
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Fayette Room- Gahanna Gaming Group

Description:
The Seekers are a junior scout troop who are tasked with finding the Mushroom before he steals all the crystals in the forest.
The Seekers is a 1 vs. Many hidden movement game where 1 player plays as the Mushroom, trying to locate the crystals hiding in the forest, while the others play as the Seekers, using deduction to learn where the Mushroom is. It's like the ultimate game of hide and seek!
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2430 - 6x30 Tables

Event Name: Play To Win - Eggs and Empires
Description: Winner gets a copy of the game! - The dragons of Ridback Mountain produce valuable eggs.  Send your adventurers up the mountain and into the caves to collect the most valuable eggs.  Use caution, there are only so many eggs to go around, and sometimes drago eggs explode!
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2101 - Eagle-Gryphon Games

Description: Explore all 63 US national parks in this causal set collecting card game that balances building your own sets of national parks while strategically delaying others. The deisgner Jason Wong spent 3 years traveling to all 63 US national parks and created a mahjong-inspired card game that features all his own photography.
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Exhibit Hall Booth - #2505 - Pocket Parks

Event Name: Meeples at Sea BIG game giveaway #2
Description: Stop by the Meeples at Sea booth for the chance to win our BIG game giveaway on Friday and Saturday at 5pm.
Room: Meeples at Sea

Description: Play elite agents in a tabletop RPG on a covert mission in the grimdark Warhammer 40,000 universe. Board a drifting space hulk, face the horrors within, and recover a highly classified asset. Rules taught at the table, no experience required, pregens to be provided.
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Knox Room

Event Name: Learn to Play Luminous Card Game
Description: Learn how to play Luminous, a 1v1 expandable card game where factions vie for control of a mysterious continent. Players will use pre-constructed decks from our starter set, The Wanderers. After completing their match, players will receive a limited, alternate frame promo of "Quinn, Crown Prince" as a reward.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2426 - 8x30

Description: A fast-paced & addictive game of gem collecting & card development. Players are merchants of the Renaissance trying to buy gem mines with means of transportation and shops all in order to acquire the most prestige points. You might even receive a visit from a noble at some point that will further increase your prestige.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2322 - Rising Phoenix Gaming Club

Description: Try the party game that's always a blast. Find your teammates, establish trust, and exchange hostages before time runs out and the bomb explodes!
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - 2nd Floor - Above Reg - Short North Ballroom Foyer

Description: Each player will open 3 packs each and take turns choosing and passing cards to build a deck. 3 Rounds, Best-of-1. Each player will earn 1 pack per match won.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2500 - Pro-Play Games

Description: You deserve a better dungeon crawler! This competitive deck-builder features easy rules, strategic decisions, and short waits between turns. Players will equip their characters, loot the dungeon, and slay monsters in a race to kill the dungeon boss.
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2518 - ProtoCLE

Event Name: Informal Game Demos - Beyond Fun Friday
Description: Drop in and try out the games mentioned in the Beyond Fun Friday session to see what actual educators do with some published games in their own classrooms. Talk to likeminded teachers, suggest some games others might try or play a game with friends in this informal setting.
Room: GCCC - 2nd Floor - Meeting A 214 - Edu Conference

Description: A fast paced, easy to learn game about 14th Century Europe and the outbreak of the Plague - He who dies last wins! Based on our 1993 cult classic, Plague & Pestilence, Of Popes and Plagues is a game for 2-6 players... 5 minutes to learn... 20-30 minutes to play. Each player grows their village while waging war on their enemies and leading Holy Crusades while preparing for the outbreak of the Black Death. Drop in and learn to play - He who dies last wins!
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2434 - 6x30 Tables

Event Name: River Valley Glassworks - Learn to Play
Description: The beautiful pieces of glass that can be found along the river have attracted the most entrepreneurial of woodland creatures. Store the glass you pick up strategically in your shop. Depending on how the glass pieces are placed, your score will change drastically.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2300 - Allplay Games

Description: Sparks Interactive. Everyone enjoys a little downtime, especially our overworked heroes. Come and interact with the other heroes of the Rebellion.  Get in a little training or just brush up on your social skills. Players must have an existing Sparks character for this event. Game Base 7’s WEG ongoing Star Wars campaign. Sponsored by: Game Base 7.
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Madison Room- Game Base 7

Description: Each year, the graduating classes of the Ravenrealm Magic School compete to demonstrate their mastery of magic. For the final exam, all the wizards of each class must assemble at the legendary Ravenskeep, but every last one of them has procrastinated, distracted by learning new spells. They’ve also used all their potions; they can’t show up unprepared, with empty potion bottles! Help your wizards get to Ravenskeep as quickly as possible. Using their magic they could even move the very towers atop which they stand to get there more easily!
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - 1st Floor - Meeting D 180-D 183 Pride Gamers

Description: You are passengers aboard The Gauntlet, a long-range transport ferrying people and cargo between sectors. FTL jumps take weeks, so everyone sleeps in cryo to conserve resources. You wake to klaxons and flashing lights. Cryo-pods hiss open. The crew is gone. Something has gone very wrong.
Room: Hyatt - 1st Floor - Hayes Room- Lurking Fears

Event Name: Japanese Riichi Mahjong - Learn to Play
Description: If you have seen Japanese style Riichi Mahjong in an anime, manga, TV show, or one of many video games and want to learn how to play yourself, you’re in the right place! We’re prepared to walk you through your first game with a single-page reference sheet to take you from knowing nothing to being able to play a game with minimal help. Mahjong is a tile game focused on set collection with many variants. It is similar in many ways to card games like Gin Rummy where players race to complete valid hands containing sequences and triplets.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2530 - Rounds

Description: Discover and collect various types of flower dragons while trying to earn prestige by planting and claiming beautiful gardens of flowers for the next migration of dragons.
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Exhibit Hall Booth - #2219 - B.A. Games

Death awaits as they encounter several hellish carnival oddities like The Ball Pit, The Feast of Kings, and test your might at The Strong Man Game. Will you fight your way through the twisted maze of carnival attractions and hellish clowns, or will the future of your village be lost forever to the traveling carnival?
Room: Hyatt - Union Rooms Foyer

Description: A multi-use card game where weather stations for 4 cities will compete to complete forecasts and victory points. Meet the designer and/or artist. This is an early access game.
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2518 - ProtoCLE

Featuring real Seneca Lake wineries, you step into the role of a Sommelier to master the art of pairing. Use your unique Sommelier Card bonuses to gain an edge—perhaps you favor Herbal notes or Spicy foods. Every pairing counts!
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2430 - 6x30 Tables

You and your friends meet up at a bar during happy hour, but the bar keeps getting busier and busier! Can you navigate your friends through the shuffling crowd to have the most fun of all?!

Hey, Bartender is a competitive, easy to learn board game with a unique NPC movement component. LEARN TO PLAY.

Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2200 - Night Crew Games

Description: New to speed puzzling? Start here! Learn tips and tricks to build faster, then try it yourself with a guided 100 piece practice puzzle. As it will be happening at the tail end of a competition, it is seat dependent. If you're not able to register, still feel free to come by the Cobble Hill booth to ask if you can join. Cobble Hill will do their best to accommodate.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)

Description: Something was missing when the good Witches & Wizards of Joralee shaped their isles of magic – Friends!! Invite all your favorite whimsical creatures, but don’t forget their beloved toys & snacks. Joralee is easy to learn and delivers complex gameplay. You must place combinations of creature, snack, & toy cards so they simultaneously satisfy all the requirements of your Island Harmony Cards. Push your luck by rolling dice to select, place, stack, & rearrange your cards. Score the most points by puzzling out a perfectly balanced island to win!
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2434 - 6x30 Tables

Event Name: Battlestar Galactica the Board Game with Expansions
Description: We will play with elements of the Pegasus, Exodus and Daybreak expansions, as the ragtag fugitive fleet tries to complete its lonely quest to find Earth. Will you be a Human or a Skinjob? Will you help or attempt to sabotage the fleet? Play Starbuck, Apollo, Adama, Tigh, Helo, Baltar, Boomer and others. Solve crises by pooling your skills while the hidden or revealed Cylon player tries to hinder your efforts. Game time includes set-up, rules explanation and game play. By your command!
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2526 - 8x30

Event Name: All Things Tank Duel:  Enemy in the Crosshairs
Description: This is your chance to learn about the past, present and future of GMT’s Tank Duel system.  The discussion will be tailored for attendees’ interests and likely topics include:  general status of Tank Duel; Tank Pack #2, the Tank Duel reprint, and Upgrade Kit; the various paths to get to the latest/greatest; and future plans for Tank Duel.  This is also your chance to get your questions answered, give feedback/comments, and make suggestions regarding Tank Duel and its future.  Hosted by Tank Pack #2 developer, Chris Huntington.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - 2nd Floor - Meeting Room D #284 - Seminars & Panels

Event Name: FaeKin: A simple but elegant social deduction game
Description:
Join us to play FaeKin, an elegant social deduction game where everyone can lie... but no one has to.
Born from the forbidden love between the heirs of the Summer and Winter Fae Courts, your parents are gone, leaving the realm in a quandary. To decide your fate, the Fae have devised a game. Crown the player in your court with the highest value identity and dagger the rival player with the highest rank to win! Information is revealed with each duel. Can you trust your own instincts, let alone your fellow Fae?
Age Range: Kid Friendly (8+, 12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: Lioness Games  - Exhibit Hall Booth 2605

Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2200 - Night Crew Games

Description: Come check out a unique horror TTRPG played with cards instead of dice where you are swallowed by the great Leviathan that took Jonah, who didn't repent to those above, but made a bargain to bring souls to those below to spare himself... Soon to be published in the Monthly RPG Zine club!

Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)

Description: The CSS H.L. Hunley sank three times during its service, with the most notable sinking occurring on February 17, 1864, after it successfully attacked and sank the USS Housatonic, taking all eight crew members with it. Room: GCCC - 2nd Floor - Meeting Room A #211 - War College

Event Name: AD&D 1E: Escape from the Isle of Dread
Description: The Prince’s expedition that you guarded is lost among the thick steaming jungle that surrounds you. Only you few have survived thus far. Finding the anchorage—finding your ship—is  your only hope to escape from -- the Isle of Dread! AD&D 1st Edition teaching game! Learn the game rules as you play!Level 3 / 6 Players / Pre-gen Characters provided
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Delaware A-D Rooms- The Gathering

Description:
A Mingdai ceramic may have surfaced. These rare, valuable items are seldom whole. Your informant says this one is pristine. There will be protections of course, traps & guards but with your expertise this job should be a breeze, & the payoff may be a wish!
Years ago, your exploits together began with the theft of the Lisa Mona. You’ve "earned" a city & stronghold of your own with impressive defenses, and new land & titles from the King of Kalendros & Anashaz, the dragon who really rules Kalendros. You’ve also made quite a few enemies.
This is an installment in the "Steal the Lisa Mona" series.
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Delaware A-D Rooms- The Gathering

Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2322 - Rising Phoenix Gaming Club

Description: Back by popular demand! Play this great board game in large scale! Build and manage a farm in 17th century Europe, with crops, livestock, buildings, improvements, and more. Each player board is the size of a table, with room to build your house, plow your fields, and fence your pastures. Prizes!
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2409 - Boar's Head Games

Description: You and your party journey through the most dangerous valley known to man, all to keep the Starchild alive! In this co-op card game, you'll face creatures and challenges unlike anything you've ever seen, but make your moves wisely--your hand size is also your HP!
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2534 - Rounds

Description:
Each player holds 3 cards & on a turn a player draws 1 card, then plays 1 card. By playing cards, you can put new rules into play that change numerous aspects of the game: how many cards to draw or play. Choose from over 20 possible decks brought by the GMs. Pirate, Zombie, Monty, Python, Marvel, Basic, & more.

GMs will be running two simultaneous session with up to 4 players in each.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)
Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2409 - Boar's Head Games

Description: You are DEVIL’S ADVOCATE, a special class of Demon & Fiend given the grace of a powerful Devil you go forth and act upon your desires. The role of DA was to be a soldier in endless war against other DA's… but now their role has shifted… to Pest Control. You help make space with high impact VIOLENCE!
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Delaware A-D Rooms- The Gathering

Description: In this developmental system you will play in a Final Fantasy setting. The scenario centers on an investigation into a corporate-controlled world and a buried truth about identity, power, and the planet itself. Players uncover Shinra’s exploitation of Mako energy, trace the rise of eco resistance. Game Designer.is asking for feedback from the players. You have the opportunity to help streamline the game. GM is not the designer.
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Delaware A-D Rooms- The Gathering

Description: This game is a miniatures-based combined-arms mass-combat game that uses all the units you know from Battletech. It is designed to let you play larger scale battles in a few hours or a smaller game much quicker. It is also miniatures-based, which means the board is not hexed like in classic Battletech and instead miniatures rules are used.  This event will teach all of the basics of the game system so you can then feel confident to play on your own or in our other Alpha Strike events.
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)

Each player takes on a colorful character with unique special abilities, then rolls and places their dice to complete objectives to win over the crowd.

But the land here also has a will, and when humanity breaks the bargains made, the land and its power will remind people where they stand. Heed the warnings of those who deal with The Green, or reap the whirlwind.

I will demonstrate a step-by-step process for using AI to understand randomness and simulate outcomes, using real board game examples.

What they all discover beneath the rubble will change the history of REDEMPTION forever and send them on a season of interdimensional adventures chasing down the traitorous Director, Maxwell Heisenberg, before it is too late.

CW: character death, mental health loss, eldritch horror, vampires
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Marion Room

This 8-table tournament will see 6-payer crews earning points, with the winners earning over $300 in prizes! 3rd-level pregens provided, or bring your own pirate that's Gained Experience twice.

Mr. Krause’s family claims he simply fell overboard while drunk, which smells fishy. The Sheriff insists he absolutely does not need the Mavens to solve the whole mystery, of course, that’s what the police department is for. Eight suspects, four locations, and clues a-plenty. Can you help the Mavens solve the mystery? CW: Cults, little old ladies, cosmic horror
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Marion Room

Description:
Welcome to Willam, an fishing village on the coast of Neo Babylon. The flood is looking way worse than usual this year, and they don't have Envoy's in the community to help out. You've been dispatched by the Envoy Union, and there's a pretty good chance you'll have to hit the ground running. You'll be thrown inbetween age old feuds that you've never heard of, all while the undertones of "why?" the flood is worse this year give an omen; there's mysterious forces at work...

Are you ready for Chaos?

Event Name: Masquerade Ball: Two Castles and a Wedding (Maybe)
Description:
The kingdoms of Mountain and Valley are due to be united. The long specter of war has been banished by the announcement that the Princess of each kingdom will marry the Prince of the other, binding Mount and Valley in a lasting union. The generals, who have been preparing for battle for months, have been seen sulking at the celebratory banquet.
Masquerade Ball is a social deduction/diplomacy game in development. Every game is played using a unique scenario. You never know what might happen at the ball—or which lies might be told.  Note: standing and walking will be required!
Room: GCCC - 2nd Floor - Above Reg - Short North Ballroom B

Room: GCCC - 2nd Floor - Meeting Room B #244 - Chicago ConLARP

Room: GCCC - Hall C - #2518 - ProtoCLE

The losers will no long be concerned with either. You and your team will face challenges for resources, weapons and supplies, then battle for supremacy. Or will you try to turn the tables and fight the game itself? But you’ll be fighting even more than your fellow competitors...
Room: Hyatt - 2nd Floor - Champaign Room

Using only one and two-word cues, players try to get others to guess a specific hue from the 480 colors on the game board. The closer the guesses are to the target, the more points you earn. Since everyone imagines colors differently, connecting colors and clues has never been this much fun!
Age Range: All Ages (12 and under must be with an adult)

INTR03: Burden of Proof
You have found refuge in an old barn, surrounded by creaking walls and rusted tools. As the barn doors open, light floods the room, revealing a gruesome sight you had not seen in the darkness—and villagers blaming you for the carnage. Can you prove your innocence, or did you commit this act of violence? A roleplay-intensive adventure for those wishing to try The Land: Roleplaying System, based on the bestselling Chaos Seeds books by Dr. Aleron Kong. Event Name: Crafting Curriculum as a Five Room Dungeon
Description:
Jason Cox, PhD, MAT & BFA
“The Five Room Dungeon” is a narrative structure used in tabletop role-playing games to construct adventures reminiscent of Joseph Campbell’s “Hero’s Journey”, and can be scaled to fit different time frames and settings. This presentation applies that structure as scaffolding in constructivist curriculum design, uses a distance learning art education course and the curriculum guide of the educational role-playing game Five Hundred Year Old Vampire as examples, and introduces a unit plan template built around the emergent questions of the structure.

Event Name: The Long Rest: Using Applied Gaming to Deconstruct Trauma
Description:
Grant D. Sparks, MS, LPC, LPCC, NCC, CGT
Tabletop role‑playing games like Dungeons & Dragons have emerged as powerful tools in therapeutic and educational spaces. Through guided fantasy, role‑play, and collaborative storytelling, players practice communication, conflict resolution, and emotional regulation. TTRPGs integrate concepts such as Wise Mind, dream work, and transference, offering a lower‑pressure, indirect way to explore difficult experiences—especially for those who find traditional therapy challenging.

Description: If you have seen Japanese style Riichi Mahjong in an anime, manga, TV show, or one of many video games and want to learn how to play yourself, you’re in the right place!
